tei:div.tei:p: (nga )༄༅// thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho lha lnga'i sgrub thabs gtor dbang las tshogs dang bcas pa'i skor rnams bzhugs so// ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ ārya lo ke shwa ra gu hya sā dha nā ma/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gsang ba'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ dpal padma gar gyi dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ni// tshe 'di nyid la thob byed pa'i// spyan ras gzigs dbang sgrub thabs bshad// dad brtson snying rjer ldan pa yis// dbang dang dam tshig ldan byas nas// dur khrod g.ya' ri gangs brag gi /nyams dga' dben pa'i gnas dag tu// phyi rgyud pa la gtor ma btang*// maṇḍal gru bzhi dris byugs pa// chang dang bdud rtsis chag chag gdab// chos 'byung bsnol ma pad 'dab brgyad// mu khyud gru chad ldan par bri// sgo bzhi rgyan ldan bris kyang rung*// rdo rje'i rwa ba me ris bskor// chos 'byung dmar po re khā dkar// mtshams su g.yung drung 'khyil pa bri// pad 'dab phyogs mdog mtshams mdzes tshon// gru chad ljang la sgo bzhi phyogs// sgo rgyan la sogs spyi dang mthun// de dbus bum pa rgyan ldan du// chang dang bdud rtsi ril bu brub// dgos pa'i cha rkyen tshang bar bzhag /thod pa chang dang bdud rtsis dgang*// bum pa'i khar bzhag dar dmar dgab// me long chang gis byugs pa la// sindhu ra bdal chos 'byung dang*// sa bon yi ge sngags bcas dgod// thod pa'i kha ru bzhag pa'i steng*// sman sna rin chen sna tshogs dang*// dri bzang dag ni sna tshogs pa// ka ra bu ram sbrang rtsi sogs// 'bru sna tshogs tshad phye ma la// gur gum gi waṃ sindhu ra// sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga sbyar ba'i// chang gis sbrus pa'i ril bu la// sindhu ra dang pad mtshal byug /mo sar phru mar 'khor lo bri// de yang gong gi rdzas kyis byug /ril bu 'khor lo'i lte bar bzhag /dar gyis dgab la me long khar// bzhag ste steng du dar gdugs phub// sba lcag dkar po tshigs gsum pa'i// nang du sngags dang 'khor lo gzhug

/ril bu lha grangs la sogs blug /kha bcad mgo mjug zangs kyis dkri// zhing lpags lcag 'bras btags pa la// rin chen sna lnga dung shwa dang*// shel dang pha wang long bu gdags// dar tshon sna lnga sngags ldan brgyan// dkyil 'khor dbus su gzug par bya// gtor ma mchod pa tshogs kyi rdzas// ci ltar 'byor pa'i bye brag bsham// rkang gling thod rnga tshil chen spos// zhun chen mar me la sogs bsreg /bgegs la glud sbyin mtshams bcad la// srung ba'i 'khor lo brtan par bsgom// dkon mchog spyan drangs phyag byas la// mchod cing maṇḍal phul ba ste// bdun po rnam par dag pa dang*// gsol ba drag tu gdab par bya// de dag sngon du 'gro ba'o// dngos gzhi phyi nang gsang gsum la// phyi ltar rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs// ma lus phyi ru dgod pa dang*// nang ltar lus la dgod pa dang*// gsang ba rtse la dgod pa dang*// yang gsang de nyid sems la dgod// de yang bsnyen sgrub las gsum ste// yang gsang 'bras bu'i ngo sprod bya// phyi ltar bsnyen pa bya ba ni// bde ba'i gdan la bsam gtan gyi// phyag rgyas bsdad la skyabs 'gro dang*// sems bskyed byas la stong pa'i ngang*// pad sdong kha gsum gyes pa'i dbus// nyi ma'i gdan la rang sems hrīḥ /'od 'phros sems can sgrib pa sbyangs// rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs su gyur// tshur 'dus sangs rgyas byin rlabs bsdus// hrīḥl thim pas 'od du zhu// bdag nyid spyan ras gzigs dbang sku// dmar gsal zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa// rin chen rgyan rdzogs skyil krung bzhugs// dang po'i phyag gnyis thal mo sbyar// g.yas 'og padma'i bgrang phreng dmar// g.yon pa utpal dmar po 'dzin// ral pa'i cod pan dar gyis mdzes// rin chen ze'u 'bru'i prog ldan pa// spyan dmar zhal 'dzum thugs rjes yis// sems can yongs la gzigs pa la// bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong rtsas bskor// rgyal ba rgya mtsho ma lus pa'i// dkyil 'khor thams cad 'dus pa'o// bdag gi spyi gtsug pad zla'i steng*// rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid ni// 'od dpag med pa'i ngo bo ste// skyil krung mnyam bzhag phyag rgya can// sprul pa'i sku ru bsgoms pa la// bka' brgyud bla ma rig 'dzin rnams// gcer bu spyan gsum rus rgyan can// rdo rje dril bus 'khyud pa'o// rdo rje 'chang gi rnam pas bskor// byin rlabs dbang bskur byed par bsgom// g.yas phyogs pad sdong nyi ma'i steng*// bdud bzhi'i gdan la rta mchog sku// dmar nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa// g.yas pa ḍā ru g.yon sdigs mdzub// dril bur bcas pa dku la brten// stag bsham dur khrod sbrul rgyan can// khro zhal spyan gsum mche ba gtsigs// ral pa dmar ser 'khyil ba'i dbus// rta mgo ljang zhur rta skad 'tsher// rngog ma dmar po me ltar 'bar// ma mo mkha' 'gro la sogs pa// snang srid lha 'dre dregs byed dang*// klu rnams dbang du sdud par byed// zhabs gnyis g.yas bskums g.yon brkyangs nas// ye shes me phung klong na bzhugs// 'khor du dpa' bo rgya mtsho'i tshogs// ye shes khro rgyal bcu la sogs// ha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa sgra sgrogs// snang srid zil gyis mnan par bsgom// g.yon phyogs pad sdong chos 'byung bsnol// de dbus pad nyi ro yi steng*// gsang ba ye shes sku mdog dmar// zhal gcig phyag bzhi spyan gsum pa// khro 'dzum mche gtsigs spyan rtsa dmar// dbu skra grol zhing sku stod khebs// g.yas bskums g.yon brkyangs ro steng brdzis// skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis bzhugs// g.yas kyi dang po gri gug 'phyar// 'og mas ral gri bsnams pa'o// g.yon gyi dang pos thod khrag 'dzin// 'og mas kha ṭwāṃ ga bsgrengs pa'i// mgul na dar dpyangs ḍā ru 'khrol// thod skam lnga yi dbu rgyan dang*// thod rlon lnga bcu'i do shal can// rus pa'i rgyan cha lnga yis brgyan// rin chen dar dpyangs brgyan par bsgom// me ri 'bar ba'i dbus bzhugs shing*// dpa' mo rgya mtsho mkha' 'gros bskor// ā ralli dang pheṃ gyi sgras// ma mo mkha' 'gro dbang du sdud// snang srid dbang du sdud par bsgom// 'og phyogs me rlung 'khrugs pa yi// 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus su ni// rigs bzhi'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang*// chos skyong dam can pho nya'i tshogs// phyi nang srung ma ma lus rnams// mkha' 'gro sde bzhi'i ngo bor gyur// gri gug thod pa kha ṭwāṃ bsnams// thod pa skam rlon rus rgyan can// rin chen rgyan dang dar gyi mdzes// ha ri ni sa'i sgra sgrogs shing*// gdan 'og padma 'degs par bsam// de dag rgyal ba rgya mtsho yi// dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa'o// de dag ma lus thams cad kyi// spyi bor zla steng oṃ dkar po// mgrin par pad steng āḥdamar po// snying gar nyi steng hūm̐ mthing ga

/sku gsung thugs ni byin gyis brlab// de nas gtso bo'i thugs ka ru// padma nyi ma'i gdan steng du// hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pa yis// ye shes spyan drangs mchod pa bstim// rigs lnga yum bzhi sems dpa' dang*// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang mchod pa yi// lha mor bcas pa spyan drangs bstim// mchod de dbang bskur gsol ba gdab// rgyal bas dbang bskur dgongs pa mdzad// khro bo rnams kyi bgegs bskrad cing*// sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bkra shis brjod// mchod pa'i lha mos mchod pa dang*// yum lnga'i bum pas dbang bskur bas// sdig sgrib dag nas spyi bo ru// rigs bdag snang ba mtha' yas dang*// rigs lngas dbu la brgyan par bsgom// de ltar ci srid mi skyo'i bar// gsal bar bsgom pa bskyed rim yin// bzlas pa byed pa'i dus su ni// bdag dang rta mgrin gsang ba'i yum// spyi bo'i bla ma rigs bdag dang*// kun gyi thugs kar pad nyi dang*// zla ba'i gdan la hrīḥyi mthar// sngags kyis g.yas su bskor ba las// 'od 'phros phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas mchod// mnyes nas byin rlabs dngos grub rnams// bdag la thim pas sdig sgrib dag /tshogs rdzogs dbang bzhi thob par bsam// khams gsum 'gro drug sems can la// 'od zer phog pas sdig sbyangs nas// phyi snod gzhal yas khang du gyur// nang bcud lha yi dkyil 'khor te// pho rnams spyan ras gzigs su gyur// mo rnams gsang ba ye shes la// bdud dang log 'dren rta mgrin sku// 'od dang me phung 'bar ba'i zhing*// rgyal ba rgya mtsho tshogs su bsgom// gzugs snang lha yi rang bzhin la// sgra grags thams cad sngags kyi sgra// sems kyi dran rtog chos sku'i ngang*// de ltar bzlas pa ci rigs bya// rjes su phyi snod nang bcud nas// rim gyis thams cad bdag la bsdu// bdag kyang hrīḥnas stong pa'i bar// mi dmigs ma bcos spros bral dang*// mi dmigs ci yang ma bsam par// chos sku'i ngang la ci gnas bzhag

/dge ba bsngo zhing smon lam gdab// thun mtshams lha yi nga rgyal gyis// spyod lam thams cad bya ba'o// oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ yab kyi snying po'o// oṃ hrīḥbadzra kro dha ha ya gri ba hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ rta mgrin gyi snying po'o// oṃ dhu ma gha ye na maḥswā hā/ gsang ba ye shes kyi snying po'o// ḍā ki nī ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya/ mkha' 'gro sde bzhi yab yum gyi snying po'o// ba su siddhi nā nā khā dhi siddhi pha la hūm̐/ siddhi siddhi sa ma ya sdus sdus/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ puṣṭiṃ bā shaṃ ku ru hūm̐/ ratna siddhi sa ma ya hrīṃ hrīṃ dzaḥdzaḥ dbang du sdud pa'i snying po'o// de ltar phyi sgrub bsnyen pa la// dkyil 'khor bca' gzhi mi dgos shing*// rgyun du yi dam nar mar bya// nang ltar 'jig rten dbang phyug gi /lus la lha rnams dgod pa ni// sngon 'gro yan lag bdun pa dang*// skyabs su 'gro zhing sems bskyed nas// tshad med bzhi yis blo sbyangs te// stong pa'i ngang las pad nyid dang*// zla ba'i gdan la rang sems hrīḥ// dmar po 'od 'phros 'dus pa las// gong ltar bdag nyid spyan ras gzigs// 'jig rten dbang phyug sku mdog dmar// zhal gcig phyag bzhi zhabs skyil krung*// rgyan rdzogs 'ja' 'od dbus bzhugs pa// phyi sgrub ci lta ba ru gsal// bla ma rigs bdag bka' brgyud bcas// spyi bor rdo rje 'chang ltar bsgom// snying ni padma 'dab brgyad steng*// nyi zla'i gdan la rta mgrin ni// dmar nag dur khrod chos kyi brgyan// g.yas pa dbang sdud phyag rgya yis// padma'i phreng ba dmar po 'dren// g.yon pa utpal dmar po yi// zhags pa sdigs mdzub bcas pa yis// dku la brten nas gar stabs mdzad// de yi thugs kar padma dang*// nyi ma'i dbus su hrīḥl sngags// g.yas su 'khor bar bsgom pa'o// lte bar chos 'byung bsnol ma'i steng*// padma nyi ma ro steng du// gsang ba ye shes ḍā ki ma// gsang gnas padma 'dab bzhi'i steng*// rigs bzhi'i mkha' 'gro yab yum ste// shar du rdo rje mkha' 'gro dkar// lho ru rin chen mkha' 'gro ser// nub tu padma mkha' 'gro dmar// byang du las kyi mkha' 'gro ljang*// yab rnams yum dang mtshungs pa ste// gri gug thod khrag rgyan dang ldan// lte ba'i yum gyi gdan nas btegs// de nas sku gsung thugs byin brlab// ye shes bstim zhing dbang bskur bsam// lte ba'i 'og tu gtum mo'i me// 'bar ba la dmigs rlung bzung bas// gang byed dbang bsdus byang sems rang bzhin bzhus// rngubs nas me la bstims pas ye shes 'bar// 'khor 'das gnyis med dgongs pa bskyang bar bya// phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas spyan drangs rlung dang bsre// me la bstims pas dbang bskur bde chen bskyed// 'gro drug sems can dbang sdud byang sems bsgom// snying rje'i ngang du rlung rngubs me la bstim// sprul skus 'gro 'dul phrin las cir yang ston// dmigs med ngang nas rlung bzung cir mi dgongs// mkha' ltar dag pa'i chos sku mngon du 'gyur// sngags bzla dus su 'od zer lcags kyu'i dbyibs// me ltar tsha la gdung ba'i tshogs 'phros pas// skye 'gro'i snying nas bzung nas bkug byas pas// rig pa'i ngo bo thugs ka'i hrīḥl thim// lus po 'od du zhu nas lte bar bsdu// yab yum mkha' 'gro pho mo'i snying po la// dngos grub sdud pa'i sngags btags bzlas pa bya// rjes su rdzogs rim lha rnams rang sar gzhug

/mkha' la sprin dwangs lta bur gsal ba'i ngang*// ma bcos dmigs gtad med pa'i ngang nyid nas// ma yengs blo yis mi dpyad ma bsgom par// gzung 'dzin yid byed blang dor med pa yi// dngos po'i rang gshis gsal dwangs bde stong nyams// chags 'dzin mi bya rnam dag de ngang bskyal// rjes su thun mtshams bya ba gong ltar spyad// nang lus la lha dgod pa ste sgrub pa'o// gsang ba rtsa la dgod pa yi// rim pa nyams su blang bya ba// gdan la bsam gtan phyag rgyas gnas// sngon 'gro yan lag bdun pa bya// skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi// shū dzñā tā yis stong par bsgom// chos nyid stong par byang chub dang*// chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes su// stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi dang*// zla ba rgyas pa'i gdan bsgom pa// nyi zla'i gdan la mngon byang chub// me long lta bu'i ye shes so// gdan steng rang nyid yi ge hrīḥ// gsung gi 'bru la mngon byang chub// mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes so// hrīḥlas padma hrīḥs mtshan pa// thugs kyi phyag mtshan mngon byang chub// so sor rtog pa'i ye shes so// padma hrīḥs mtshan 'od zer gyis// 'gro ba'i rgyud sbyangs lhar gyur nas// sangs rgyas rnams kyi byin rlabs bsdus// sngar gyi padma hrīḥs mtshan thim// de nyid yongs su gyur pa las// bdag nyid lha yi sku rdzogs pa// sku yongs rdzogs par mngon byang chub// bya grub nan tan ye shes so// de yang bdag nyid spyan ras gzigs// zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dmar// g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum gar gyis bsgyings// dbu skra gyen brdzes dar gyis brgyan// rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes par spras// phyag g.yas pad phreng g.yon padma// gsang ba ye shes yum gyis 'khyud// dmar mo gcer bu spyan gsum pa// phyag g.yas gri gug g.yon thod khrag /thod pa skam po rus rgyan can// rin chen sna tshogs dar dpyangs brgyan// ye shes me ri'i dbus na bzhugs// de yi sku la rtsa gsum dang*// 'khor lo bzhi po gsal btab la// spyi bo bde chen 'khor lo la// rtsa 'dab sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi// dbus su bde gshegs spyan ras gzigs// dkar po 'khor lo dril bu can// bde gshegs mkha' 'gro sum cu gnyis// 'khor lo gri gug thod khrag can// rus pa rin chen rgyan ldan bskor// mgrin pa longs spyod 'khor lo na// rtsa 'dab bcu drug dbus su ni// padma rigs kyi spyan ras gzigs// dmar po padma dril bu can// padma mkha' 'gro bcu drug bskor// padma gri gug thod khrag can// rus pa rin chen rgyan ldan bskor// snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo la// rtsa 'dab brgyad kyi dbus su ni// rdo rje rigs kyi spyan ras gzigs// mthing ga rdo rje dril bu can// rdo rje rigs kyi mkha' 'gro brgyad// rdo rje gri gug thod khrag can// rus pa rin chen rgyan ldan bskor// lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo la// rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi'i dbus// rin chen rigs kyi spyan ras gzigs// ser po rin chen dril bu can// rin chen mkha' 'gro drug cu bzhi// rin chen gri gug thod khrag can// rus pa rin chen rgyan ldan bskor// gsang gnas nor bu'i 'khor lo ru// rtsa 'dab bzhi yi dbus su ni// las kyi rigs kyi spyan ras gzigs// ljang gu rgya gram dril bu can// las kyi mkha' 'gro ljang gu bzhi// rgya gram gri gug thod khrag thogs// rus pa rin chen rgyan ldan bskor// yab kyi thugs kar rta mgrin dang*// spyi bor bla ma lte ba ru// dpa' bo sde bzhi bsgom par bya// yum gyi thugs kar zhal gnyis ma// spyi bor na bza' dkar mo dang*// lte bar rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro bsgom// kun kyang thod pa skam rlon dang*// rin chen rus rgyan dar gyis mdzes// padma nyi zla ro gdan can// me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus su 'gying*// de ltar gsal bar bsgoms byas nas// sku gsung thugs gsum byin brlab ste// ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs bstim// dbang bskur dbang rtags kyis brgyan la// de nas rang gi 'dom bar nas// yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor g.yos// gsang gnas lha tshogs me 'bar te// 'khor lo bzhi yi gtso bo rnams// ltos thag med pa'i me 'bar te// lte ba'i a la gtugs nas ni// spyi bo'i haṃ la reg pa yis// byang chub sems kyi rgyun babs pas// 'khor lo rnam bzhi gang ba yis// lha rnams bde ba chen por 'bar// dus gsum rgyal ba ma lus dang*// skye 'gro sems can byams sdang sogs// dus dang gnad du gang 'gro ba// rlung dang dbyer med bsdus la bstim// me 'bar nyon mongs rab bsregs nas// stong nyid snying rje chen po'i ngang*// gnyug ma yid la mi byed par// tha mal shes pa ma bcos dang*// rang rig skye med sbyangs byas la// rlung bzung rig pa phyogs med sbyang*// mdun gyi dkyil 'khor bum pa dang*// thod pa me long 'khor lo dang*// ril bu sba lcag dag la yang*// rang nyid ji ltar bskyed bstim bya// bdag dang de rnams thugs ka nas// 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu'i dbyibs// me ltar tsha la gdung 'phros pas// gang dmigs la sogs skye 'gro yi// pho yi snying ga mo yi ni// gsang ba'i gnas nas bzung nas ni// rang dbang med par mdun du bkug

/'od zer 'phros pas phog pa yis// de dag 'od du zhu ba las// byang sems dkar dmar rnam par gyur// ril bu la sogs rdzas rnams dang*// rang gi gsang bar bsdus la bstim// thugs ka'i hrīḥl 'dus par bsam// byams dang snying rje drag tu bsgom// rlung bzung sngags zlo gang goms bya// thun rting rdzogs rim thun mtshams su// bsngo ba smon lam spyod lam bya// thun bzhi thun drug la sogs bcad// tshogs dang gtor ma thun mtshams mchod// bstod pas bstod cing bkra shis brjod// yig brgya la sogs bshags pa bya// rtags dang cho 'phrul mkha' 'gro'i ltas// dngos grub mtshan ma la sogs pa// bzang ngan bye brag ci shar dang*// rmi lam bzang dang ngan pa sogs// gang la'ang dga' dang mi dga' ba'i// mtshan mar 'dzin par mi bya'o// de ltar zhag bdun nyer gcig sogs// zla gsum zla drug la sogs pa// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub 'gyur// de nas sgrub pa tshar rjes su// ril bu 'khor lo lus la bcang*// sindhu ra yis spyi bo dang*// dpral ba mgrin pa snying ga dang*// lte ba gsang gnas dag tu byug /bum pa'i chu yis bkru btung bya// thod chang btung la dngos grub blang*// gtor ma la sogs sbyin sreg bya// bum chu gang blud dpang du 'gyur// sba lcag gzung zhing klad la bskor// 'gro ba dbang du 'dus par bsam// sbyin sreg dkyil 'khor zla gam khar// dbang gi shing dmar zla gam brtsig /me sbar lha tshogs bskyed par bya// ye shes bstims la mchod bstod 'bul// bsreg rdzas 'dod yon sna tshogs dang*// ril bu mar dang 'bru mar bsreg /zas nor gos dang rin po che// shing thog 'bru sna ci srid 'bul// gsol ba gdab cing mchod pa bya// rjes su ye shes sems dpa' gshegs// thal ba chu bo'i gzhung du dor// de yis snang ba dbang du gyur// rtsa la dgod pa gsang sgrub ni// las sbyor lta bur bzhed pa'o// yang gsang sems la dgod pa ni// dben gnas phyi rol mi btsal te// lus 'di gzhal yas khang nyid yin// lha sku gzhan du mi btsal te// sems nyid skye 'gag med pa de// rigs kyi bdag po bla ma yin// ma rtogs nyon mongs gti mug ste// rtogs grol thugs rje chen po yin// yid byed rtog pa 'phro ba de// rtogs na sangs rgyas stong rtsa yin// zhe sdang gdug sems ldan pa de// gzhi med rtogs pa rta mgrin yin// 'dod chags gdung sems tur tur de// rtsa bral shar ba gsang ye yin// nyon mongs nga rgyal rtog tshogs rnams// ngar 'dzin bral ba dpa' bo yin// phrag dog rlung ltar 'tshubs pa de// re dogs zad pa dpa' mo yin// chu khams khrag dang rnam shes de// rdo rje rigs kyi mkha' 'gro yin// rtsa khams sha dang tshor ba ni// rin chen mkha' 'gro ma zhes grags// me khams drod dang 'du shes de// padma rigs kyi mkha' 'gro yin// rlung khams dbugs dang 'du byed de// las kyi mkha' 'gro zhes su bshad// nam mkha'i khams dang sems nyid de// gzugs kyi phung po bde gshegs rigs// padma rigs kyi mkha' 'gro yin// rlung khams dbugs dang 'du byed de// las kyi mkha' 'gro zhes su bshad// nam mkha'i khams dang sems nyid de// gzugs kyi phung po bde gshegs rigs// padma mkha' 'gro drwa ba'o// skye mched tshogs drug de yi yul// 'dod yon mchod pa'i lha mo yin// drag dang mi dge rtog tshogs rnams// dam can bka' sdod srung mar bshad// de ltar sems kyi ngo bo de// ma rtogs 'khrul pa 'khor ba ste// de shes rtogs pa mya ngan 'das// lha sku sems kyi rig rtsal de// dngos por bzung nas 'khrul pa'i phyir// lha yang sems nyid chos skur gsal// sngags ni smra brjod bral ba'i phyir// phyi nang rlung gi rgyu ba yang*// grags tshad grags stong brjod med yin// gdod nas dag pa'i rig pa ni// ye nas chos skur gnas pa la// ngo sprod de ngo shes pa yin// chos dbyings ye shes rtogs pa de// sangs rgyas zhes su grags pa'o// goms 'dris brtan na drod rtags 'char// de ltar chos sku'i ngo bo la// gzung bar bya ba'i yul yang med// khams drod rtags dang nyams myong la// ma chags rang byung rtsa nas dag

/rang don chos sku mngon gyur te// gzhan don gzugs sku lhun grub 'byung*// 'khor ba mya ngan 'da' bar 'gyur// snyan brgyud dri ma med pa'o// ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mo nas brgyud pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gi gsang sgrub rdzogs so// byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje snying pos mdzad pa'i gzhung dri ma med pa/ grub chen ti pu pa bi ma la mi tra dang*/ lo tsā ba glan dar tshul khrims kyis bsgyur cing ras chung rdo rje grags pa la gtad pa'o// ༈ /bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho lha lnga'i sgrub thabs tshigs bcad du bkod pa bzhugs so// bla ma dang thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// de nyid dbang bskur thob cing dam tshig la gnas pa'i gang zag gis rang gzhan gyi don du bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams len byed par 'dod na/ dur khrod/ g.ya' ri/ brag ri/ gangs ri la sogs pa dben zhing nyams dga' ba grub thob gong mas byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas su song la/ yar ngo dang mar ngo gang yang rung ba'i tshes bcu'i dus ji ltar 'tshams pa'i stegs bur chos 'byung gru gsum bsnol ma phyi dkar la nang dmar ba'i lte bar hrīḥyig dmar po/ zur gyi khug drug tu dga' 'khyil dkar po g.yon bskor/ chos 'byung gi phyir sna tshogs padma lte ba dmar/ mu khyud ser/ shar sngo/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang ba'i mtshams brgyad dang mu khyud dmar chen/ de'i phyi rol rgyas par na/ dkyil 'khor gru bzhi sgo bzhi/ bsdu na rdo rwa ser po/ me ri sna tshogs mdog g.yas bskor bri/ de dbus su stegs bu'i steng du rin po che'i snod chag gas med pa 'bru bzang pos phyur bur bkang ba/ steng du rin po che'i bum pa yid du 'ong ba sman rin po che 'bru sna tshogs pa dang sbyar ba'i btung bas gang ba/ kha rgyan mgul dkris dang bcas pa bkod/ bum pa'i steng du ka pā la mtshan nyid dang ldan pa bdud rtsi ril bu dang sman dri bzang rin po che zas gos sna tshogs kyis bkang ba dar dmar pos zhal khebs byas la bzhag

de'i steng du me long dri ma med pa gsal ngos su sindhu ras mtha' la zlum skor/ chos 'byung zur drug pa/ zur rnams su dga' 'khyil/ dbus su hrīḥyig gi mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ oṃ dhu ma gha ye na maḥswā hā/ zhes pa sngags mgo nang bstan gyis bskor ba/ 'dab ma bzhi'i shar du ha ra/ lhor ri tsa/ nub tu ni hri/ byang du sa ya rnams sngags mgo phyir bstan bris la bzhag dar dmar po'i gur phub/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi 'gram nub phyogs su sha chang gis brgyan pa'i gtor ma lnga'am bdun bsham/ mtha' mchod pa sna tshogs kyis bskor zhing*/ tshogs kyi yo byad kyang bshams la/ bdag nyid kyi mdun g.yon phyogs nas brtsam nang mchod/ rdo rje dril bu/ ḍā ru rnams bkod/ de nas rnal 'byor bsgom pa'i rim pa ni/ bdag nyid skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen por gyur/ nang mchod bsang chus bran la/ oṃ badzra kro dha ha ya gri wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmaḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ gis sbyang*/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las// ram̐ yam̐ kam̐ dang a spros te// 'od zhu rlung me thod sgyed steng*// thod pa phyi dkar nang dmar dbus// go ku da ha na las sha /bi mu ma ra shu rnams las// bdud rtsi'i lnga ste rlung mes sbar// rdzas su rab tu khol bar gyur// hūm̐/ thugs kyi bdud rtsi kha dog sngo/ āḥ/ gsung gi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin dmar// oṃ/ sku yi bdud rtsi dkar po ni// 'o ma'i rgya mtsho lta bur gyur// nang mchod kyi dbus su g.yon pa'i mtheb srin sbyar bas g.yon bskor du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes chos 'byung bri/ de'i dbus su bzhag nas hrīḥzhes brjod pas bdud rtsir byin brlab/ bgegs gtor bshams la bsang chu dang nang mchod kyis bran/ phyag rgya dang bcas te/ a kā ros byin gyis brlab/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyo bi shwa mu khe bhyaḥsarba thā khaṃ utga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛhne daṃ ba lyā di swā hā/

gang dag dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa la// mngon par dga' ba gang yin rnams// legs bshams mchod pa gtor ma dag /bzhes nas bdag cag 'khor bcas la// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang*// longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*// zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// dam tshig can gyi bdag la srung*// dngos grub kun gyi stong grogs mdzod// dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*// gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod// 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*// 'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel ba// bde legs phun sum tshogs pa yi// yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod// ces pas phul ba gtsang sar dor/ oṃ badzra kro dha dang*/ suṃ bha'i sngags brjod cing yungs kar gyis brab/ mtshams bcad/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba dang*// gur gyis kun nas gtams par gyur// oṃ badzra rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes srung 'khor bsgom/ mchod rdzas rnams la bdud rtsi gtor zhing bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las ka pa la// yangs pa'i nang du hūm̐ yig las// mchod rdzas dwangs shing thogs med pa// kun bzang mchod sprin lta bur gyur// oṃ badzra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra dhū pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra gandhe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra nai wi dya āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra shabda āḥhūm̐/ bdag sogs mkha' mnyam sems can rnams// dus 'di nas bzung byang chub bar// bla ma yi dam dkon mchog la// sgo gsum gus pas skyabs su mchi// nam mkha' dang mnyam sems can kun// bde ldan sdug bsngal dang bral zhing*// spyan ras gzigs kyi go 'phang slad// rim gnyis zab mo bsgom par bya// bdag nyid rgyal ba rgya mtsho ni// zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas padma// g.yon pa bgrang phreng skyil krung bzhugs// rgyan rdzogs sku mdog rab dmar ba'i// thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od 'phros pas// bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas dang*// byang sems tshogs bcas spyan drangs te// mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur// badzra sa mā dzaḥ

oṃ padma ka ma lā ya st+waṃ swā hā/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ oṃ badzra dhū pe pra tītstsha swā hā/ oṃ badzra puṣpe pra tītstsha swā hā/ oṃ badzra ā lo ke pra tītstsha swā hā/ oṃ badzra gandhe pra tītstsha swā hā/ oṃ badzra nai widya pra tītstsha swā hā/ oṃ badzra shabda pra tītstsha swā hā/ phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba ma lus dang*// byang chub sems dang rgyal sras ma lus tshogs// rdul gcig steng na rdul snyed bzhugs pa yi// bla med 'phags pa'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo// phyogs bcu dus gsum bzhugs pa yi// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// bla ma rdo rje slob dpon dang*// yi dam lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas// dus gsum bde gshegs ma lus la// gling bzhi ri rab bcas pa dang*// gling bzhi bye ba phrag brgya dang*// bye ba 'bum dang dung phyur te// maṇḍal gcig tu bsdus nas ni// mos blos gong ma rnams la 'bul// thugs rjes brtser dgongs bzhes su gsol// bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol// thog med dus nas bdag cag gi /dug gsum dbang gis sgo gsum gyi// sdom pa gsum las 'gal ba sogs// sdig pa'i las rnams mthol lo bshags// spro na ji snyed su dag nas/ byang chub phyir bsngo'o bar bzang spyod smon thung sbyar/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas la gsol ba 'debs// longs sku thugs rje chen po la gsol ba 'debs// sprul sku padma 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs// ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mo la gsol ba 'debs// te pu dri med bshes gnyen la gsol ba 'debs// ras chung rdo rje grags pa la gsol ba 'debs// bla ma zangs ri ras pa la gsol ba 'debs// 'gro mgon ras pa chen po la gsol ba 'debs// rgyal sras puṇye badzra la gsol ba 'debs// grub chen karma pakṣ-i la gsol ba 'debs// gnyan ras saṅgha lakṣa la gsol ba 'debs// chos rje rang byung rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs// mkhas grub grags pa seng ge la gsol ba 'debs// rtogs ldan mgon po rgyal mtshan la gsol ba 'debs// rang byung rol pa'i rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs// dpal ldan mkha' spyod dbang po la gsol ba 'debs// chos rje de bzhin gshegs pa la gsol ba 'debs// sog dben rig pa'i ral gri la gsol ba 'debs// grub mchog chos dpal ye shes la gsol ba 'debs// kun mkhyen mthong ba don ldan la gsol ba 'debs// byang sems dpal 'byor don grub la gsol ba 'debs// rgyal dbang chos grags rgya mtsho la gsol ba 'debs// gar dbang chos kyi grags pa la gsol ba 'debs// grub chen bkra shis dpal 'byor la gsol ba 'debs// mtshungs med mi bskyod rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs// rgyal dbang dkon mchog yan lag la gsol ba 'debs// rje btsun dbang phyug rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs// gar dbang chos kyi dbang phyug la gsol ba 'debs// lung rigs smra ba'i nyi ma la gsol ba 'debs// rje btsun karma chags med la gsol ba 'debs// dul mo karma dar rgyas la gsol ba 'debs// dpal chen chos kyi don grub la gsol ba 'debs// kun mkhyen chos kyi 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs// rgyal dbang bdud 'dul rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs// padma nyin byed dbang po la gsol ba 'debs// khyab bdag theg mchog rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs// drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs// sems can bde dang ldan gyur cig

stong par gyur// de yi ngang las rang sems hrīḥ /dmar po de las 'od 'phros pas// 'od zer las grub gzhal yas khang*// chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam par gyur// de dbus pad sdong kha gsum gyi// dbus su nyi zla'i gdan steng hrīḥ /babs pa de las 'od 'phros pas// 'gro ba'i sgrib sbyangs rgyal ba dang*// rgyal sras rnams kyi byin rlabs bsdus// hrīḥl thim pas 'od du zhu// bdag nyid spyan ras gzigs dbang pa'i cod pan dar gyis mdzes// rin chen ze'u 'bru'i prog ldan pa// spyan dmar zhal 'dzum thugs rje yis// sems can yongs la gzigs pa la// bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong gis bskor// g.yas phyogs pad sdong la sogs pa// phyag rgya drug gis rnam par brgyan// snang srid byin gyis rlob mdzad pa'i// phyag rgya gar stabs tshul gyis bzhugs// de la bka' brgyud bla ma dang*// rig 'dzin bye ba du mas bskor// 'og phyogs me rlung 'khrugs pa yi// 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus su ni// rigs bzhi'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang*// chos skyong dam can pho nya'i tshogs// phyi nang srung ma ma lus rnams// mkha' 'gro sde bzhi'i ngo bor gyur// gri gug thod pa kha ṭwāṃ bsnams// thod pa skam rlon rus rgyan can// rin chen rgyan dang dar gyis mdzes// ha ri ni sa'i sgra sgrogs shing*// gdan 'og padma 'degs par byed// de dag ma lus thams cad kyi// spyi bor zla steng oṃ dkar po// mgrin par pad steng āḥdamar po// snying gar nyi steng hūm̐ mthing ga

/gtso bo'i thugs kar pad nyi'i steng*// hrīḥyig dmar po'i 'od zer gyis// bskyed pa dang 'dra'i ye shes pa// mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs gyur// pheṃ pheṃ pheṃ/ rol mo bdug pa bcas/ hūm̐/ lho nub srin po'i grong khyer nas// grub thob bye ba 'bum gyi dbus// slob dpon padma gshegs su gsol// dbang bskur byin gyis brlab tu gsol// padma dbang gi dkyil 'khor nas// mgon po tshe dbang 'od dpag med// spyan ras gzigs dbang gshegs su gsol// dbang bskur byin gyis brlab tu gsol// mkha' spyod dag pa'i gzhal yas nas// mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum gyi dbus// yum gcig mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol// dbang bskur byin gyi brlab tu gsol// me dpung 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas// rta mchog rgyal po he ru ka /dpa' bo'i tshogs rnams gshegs su gsol// dbang bskur byin gyis brlab tu gsol// dag pa sku yi gzhal yas nas// chos dbyings ye shes ngo bo nyid// sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol// dbang bskur byin gyis brlab tu gsol// mi 'gyur thugs kyi gzhal yas nas// me long ye shes ngo bo nyid// rdo rje mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol// dbang bskur byin gyis brlab tu gsol// padma gsung gi gzhal yas nas// sor rtog ye shes ngo bo nyid// padma mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol// dbang bskur byin gyis brlab tu gsol// yon tan rgyas pa'i gzhal yas nas// mnyam nyid ye shes ngo bo nyid// rin chen mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol// dbang bskur byin gyis brlab tu gsol// phrin las grub pa'i gzhal yas nas// bya grub ye shes ngo bo nyid// las kyi mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol// dbang bskur byin gyis brlab tu gsol// 'jig rten dur khrod gzhal yas nas// bsam gyis mi khyab sprul pa'i tshogs// 'jig rten mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol// dbang bskur byin gyis brlab tu gsol// phrin las rnam bzhi bsgrub tu gsol// dam tshig chen po'i gnas mchog nas// chos skyong ma mgon lcam dral tshogs// dam can rgya mtsho gshegs su gsol// pho nya las mkhan mdzad du gsol// rgyal ba rgya mtsho spyan ras gzigs// 'gro ba'i don du byon pa legs// bdag cag bsod nams skal ba ldan// bdag gi mchod yon bzhes slad du// 'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol// oṃ padma ka ma lā ya st+waṃ swā hā/

oṃ/ mchod yon bdug spos me tog snang gsal dri// zhal zas rol mo sha lnga rigs kyi yum// zag med bde chen bdud rtsi bde ba'i gnas// sha chen gsur dud zhun chen dga' bde rgyas// snang ba sna tshogs lhan skyes ye shes bde// rang byung kun mkhyen ye shes mchod pa'i sprin// mchod par bzhes la dngos grub stsal du gsol// oṃ badzra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ oṃ badzra dhū pe pra tītstsha swā hā/ oṃ badzra puṣpe pra tītstsha swā hā/ oṃ badzra ā lo ke pra tītstsha swā hā/ oṃ badzra gandhe pra tītstsha swā hā/ oṃ badzra nai wi dya pra tītstsha swā hā/ oṃ badzra shabda pra tītstsha swā hā/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa// dbyer med chu la chu bzhag gyur// slar yang thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis// rigs lnga yum bzhi sems dpa' dang*// khro bo'i tshogs dang mchod pa yi// lha mor bcas pa spyan drangs la// oṃ badzra arghaṃ sogs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ zhes pas gsol ba btab pa'i mod// rgyal bas dbang bskur dgongs pa mdzad// khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad cing*// sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bkra shis brjod// mchod pa'i lha mos mchod pa dang*// yum bzhis bum pas dbang bskur zhing*// spyan ras gzigs dbang 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon// sangs rgyas rnams kyi bum pa'i dbang*// de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// chos dbyings ye shes dbang 'di khyod kyis longs// oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ buddha a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes pas dbang bskur sgo gsum gyi// sdig sgrib dag cing dbang bzhi thob// lha tshogs kun gyi spyi bo ru// rigs bdag snang ba mtha' yas dang*// rigs lngas dbu la brgyan par gyur// zhes ye shes pa bstim pa dang dbang bskur rgyas gdab/ mchod rdzas rnams la bdud rtsi gtor zhing bsang sbyang*/

stong pa'i ngang las ka pā la// yangs pa'i nang du hūm̐ yig las// mchod rdzas dwangs shing thogs med pa// kun bzang mchod sprin lta bur gyur// oṃ badzra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin dhū pe dang puṣpe bar du sbyar bas brlab/ oṃ/ mchod yon 'dug spos me tog snang gsal dri// zhal zas rol mo sha lnga rigs kyi yum// zag med bde chen bdud rtsi bde ba'i gnas// sha chen gsur dud zhun me dga' bde rgyas// snang ba sna tshogs lhan skyes ye shes bde// rang byung kun mkhyen ye shes mchod pa'i sprin// mchod par bzhes la dngos grub stsal du gsol// oṃ badzra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ de bzhin du dhū pe puṣpe sogs sbyar bas mchod nas/ padma dbang gi dkyil 'khor du// padma mchog gi skur sprul pa// gdug pa 'dul mdzad thod phreng rtsal// gus pa'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal 'dud// hrīḥ thugs rje chen po 'jig rten dbang phyug sku// sku mdog dmar gsal 'jig rten dbang du sdud// spyan gyi 'od zer 'gro la thugs rjes gzigs// zhal nas hūm̐ sgras stong gsum chos sgra sgrogs// shangs nas ye shes rlung gis nyon mongs 'thor// snyan gnyis thabs dang shes rab 'dul thabs mdzad// phyag gnyis dbyings dang ye shes gnyis med sbyor// g.yas pas bgrang phreng byang chub lam sna 'dren// g.yon pas padma 'khor ba'i skyon dang bral// zhabs gnyis 'gro ba'i don la mnyam par bzhugs// rin chen rgyan drug pha rol phyin drug ldan// 'gro rnams ma lus thugs rjes dbang du sdud// 'jig rten dbang phyug sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// hūm̐/ dus gsum bde gshegs yum gcig ma// thugs rje'i mnga' bdag 'gro la gzigs// gsang ba ye shes mkha' 'gro ma// sku mdog dmar mo dbang gi tshul// tshad med rnam bzhis 'gro don mdzad// rnam rtog rtsad gcod gri gug g.yas// 'khor ba dbang sdud thod khrag g.yon// skye 'chi rtsad gcod ral gri g.yas// dug gsum rtsad gcod kha ṭwāṃ g.yon// thabs dang shes rab brkyang bskum bzhugs// 'dod yon rang dag rus pas brgyan// gzhon nu'i cha lugs cung zad khro// thugs rje'i chags pas dbang du sdud// nam mthong dran pas ye shes skyed// thugs rje'i spyan gyis 'gro la gzigs// rdo rje rigs kyi mkha' 'gro mas// rdo rje rigs kyi dngos grub stsol// rin chen rigs kyi mkha' 'gro mas// nor dang bsod nams dngos grub stsol// padma rigs kyi mkha' 'gro mas// chags pa dbang sdud dngos grub stsol// las kyi rigs kyi mkha' 'gro mas// dgra bgegs tshar gcod dngos grub stsol// mkha' gsang ye shes mkha' 'gro mas// chos dbyings lhun grub dngos grub stsol// mahā mu dra'i dngos grub stsol// hūm̐/

thugs kyi lha mchog rta mgrin dbang gi rgyal// sku mdog dmar nag dregs pa dbang du sdud// spyan gyi 'od zer 'gro la thugs rjes gzigs// zhal gyi 'dzum tshul thugs rjes kun la snyoms// mche bzhi gtsigs pas skye 'chi rtsad nas gcod// dbu gtsug rta mgo gzhan gyis 'gran du med// rta skad 'tsher bas khams gsum dbang du sdud// dbang sdud phyag rgyas skye 'gro zil gyis gnon// padma'i phyag mtshan 'khor ba'i skyon dang bral// rin chen rgyan cha 'dod yon ma spangs dag /zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum ye shes sems dpa'i tshul// dbang chen rta mchog sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs// sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// bsdu ba rnam bzhis 'jig rten dbang du sdus// 'jig rten zil gnon phrin las dngos grub stsol// sngar ltar bdud rtsi mtheb srin gyis mchod cing*/ snang ba mtha' yas spyan gzigs padma 'byung*// grub pa'i rgyal mo ti pu ras chung pa// zangs ri ras pa ras chen spom brag pa// karma pakṣi'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// bla ma gnyan ras rang byung grags seng ba// mgon po rgyal mtshan rol rdor mkha' spyod dbang*// de bzhin gshegs pa rig pa'i ral gri dang*// chos dpal ye shes zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// don ldan go shrī chos grags rgya mtsho'i zhabs// spyan snga chos grags gnyan pa mi bskyod rje// dkon mchog yan lag dbang phyug rdo rje dang*// chos kyi dbang phyug zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// lung rigs nyi ma chags med dul mo ba// chos kyi don grub chos 'byung bdud 'dul rje// padma nyin byed theg mchog rdo rje 'chang*// rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// zhes pas bla ma brgyud pa rnams dang*/ rje btsun 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug dang*// bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// rdo rje rin chen padma las kyi rigs// spyan ras gzigs bzhi rigs kyi yum bzhi mchod// rigs bzhi'i mkha' 'gro dpa' bo rgya mtsho dang*// dpa' mo rgya mtsho grub pa brnyes pa rnams// dam can rgya mtshor bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'bul gyi// bzhes nas dbang bskur byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes pas dkyil 'khor pa la 'bul/

de nas oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod cing bdud rtsi mchod rdzas dang gnas khang dang rang nyid kyi lus la gtor/ lce thog tu myang*/ mdun bskyed la dmigs pa'i bzlas pa cung zad bya/ de nas tshogs rdzas rnams la bdud rtsi 'thor zhing*/ oṃ badzra kro dha ha ya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ gis sbyang*/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las// ram̐ yam̐ kam̐ dang a spros te// 'od zhu rlung me thod sgyed steng*// thod pa phyi dkar nang dmar dbus// go ku da ha na las sha/ bi mu ma ra shu rnams las// bdud rtsi lnga ste rlung mes sbar// rdzas zhu rab tu khol bar gyur// hūm̐/ thugs kyi bdud rtsi kha dog sngo// āḥ gsung gi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin dmar// oṃ/ sku yi bdud rtsi dkar po ni// 'o ma'i rgya mtsho lta bur gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ zhes mang du brjod pas byin gyis brlab nas/ na mo/ thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med pa'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po 'di/ rang bzhin rnam par dag pa skye ba med pa/ ngo bo rnam par dag pa ā li kā li/ mchod nyid rnam par dag pa sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas rgyas btab pa 'di 'phul ba'i gnas ni/ byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba bka' brgyud bla ma rnams kyi zhal du kha raṃ khā hi/ dngos grub kyi rtsa ba yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du kha raṃ khā hi/ phrin las kyi rtsa ba chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi zhal du kha raṃ khā hi/ zhes lan gsum/ hūm̐/ chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang nas// slob dpon padma dbang gi lha// rnam 'phrul mkha' la sprin ltar gtibs// 'dir gshegs tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes// padma dbang gi dkyil 'khor nas// mgon po tshe dbang 'od dpag med// rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dbus nas bzhengs// 'dir gshegs tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes// mkha' spyod dag pa'i gzhal yas nas// gsang ba ye shes ḍā ki ma// mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbus nas bzhengs// 'dir gshegs tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes// me dpung 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas// khro bo'i rgyal po rta mchog dpal// dpa' bo rgya mtsho'i dbus nas bzhengs// 'dir gshegs tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes// sa bla sa 'og sa steng gi

/nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gnas mchog nas// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho rnams// 'dir gshegs tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes// dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad nas// 'jig rten mkha' 'gro rdzu 'phrul can// 'dir gshegs tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes// pho nya las mkhan mdzad du gsol// dam tshig chen po'i gnas mchog nas// dam can rgya mtsho sku bskyod 'tshal// 'dir gshegs tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes// phrin las rnam bzhi bsgrub tu gsol// de nas tshogs phud gtor mar bran la/ gtor ma tshogs mchod ltar byin brlabs te/ rdo rje thal mo kha phye bas/ na mo ratna gu ru i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ longs sku thugs rje chen po/ sprul sku padma 'byung gnas/ ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mo/ ti pu pa dri med bshes gnyen/ ras chung rdo rje grags pa/ bla ma zangs ri ras pa/ 'gro mgon ras pa chen po/ rgyal sras spom brag pa/ grub chen karma pakṣi/ gnyan ras dge 'dun 'bum/ chos rje rang byung rdo rje/ mkhas grub grags pa seng ge rtogs ldan mgon po rgyal mtshan/ rang byung rol pa'i rdo rje/ dpal ldan mkha' spyod dbang po/ chos rje de bzhin gshegs pa/ rje btsun ratna bha dra/ grub mchog chos dpal ye shes/ kun mkhyen mthong ba don ldan/ byang sems dpal 'byor don grub/ rgyal dbang chos grags rgya mtsho/ gar dbang chos kyi grags pa/ sangs rgyas gnyen pa grub chen/ mtshungs med mi bskyod rdo rje/ rgyal ba dkon mchog yan lag rje btsun dbang phyug rdo rje/ gar dbang chos kyi dbang phyug lung rigs smra ba'i nyi ma/ 'gro mgon karma chags med/ dul mo karma dar rgyas/ dpal chen chos kyi don grub/ kun mkhyen chos kyi 'byung gnas/ rgyal dbang bdud 'dul rdo rje/ padma nyin byed dbang po/ theg pa mchog gi rdo rje la sogs pa drin chen rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma rnams kyi zhal du 'bul lo// byin gyis rlob par mdzad du gsol/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ oṃ badzra kro dha ha ya grī ba hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭaḥ i daṃ ba liṃ sogs/ oṃ dhu ma gha ye na maḥswā hā/ ha ra ni sa ra tsa hri ya hūm̐ dzaḥ i daṃ sogs btags pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal ba rgya mtsho/ dpa' bo rgya mtsho/ dpa' mo rgya mtsho/ grub thob rgya mtsho/ dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du 'bul lo// mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ yi dam chos skyong gzhan gyi gtor ma 'bul bar spro na so so'i lugs ltar ram/ spyi tsam du mdor bsdus pa 'di bzhin sbyar te/ oṃ/ chos dbyings rnam dag ngang las rlung me dang*// thod pa'i sgyed pur padma bhañdza'i snod// yangs shing rgya cher sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga// rlung mes bskol bas dam tshig bdud rtsi 'bar// 'bru gsum 'od kyis ye shes bdud rtsi bkug /kha dog dri ro nus bcud phun sum tshogs// 'dod yon mchod sprin nam mkha' gang bar 'phro// zag med bde ba skyed pa'i dam rdzas 'dis// rdo rje 'chang nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar// bka' brgyud bla ma grub thob rgya mtsho mchod// phyogs bcu dus gsum sangs rgyas sras dang bcas// 'jig rten dbang phyug rgyal ba rgya mtsho mchod// rgyud sde bzhi drug yi dam dkyil 'khor lha// dbang chen rta mgrin dpa' bo rgya mtsho mchod// rigs lnga'i rang bzhin gnas yul dur khrod skyong*// gsang ba ye shes mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho mchod// ma hā kā la lcam dral bka' 'khor bcas// ye shes las dang 'jig rten tshul 'dzin cing*// bstan pa skyong dang rnal 'byor grogs mdzad pa// 'das dang ma 'das dam can rgya mtsho mchod// gtsang ris dpal mgon lha srin sde brgyad tshogs// dkar phyogs skyong mdzad dge bsnyen dam tshig can// yul gzhi gnas kyi bdag po mthu bo che// gtsug lag khang dang chos 'khor skyong rnams mchod// sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las la// rab tu gus pas bstod cing bsngags par bgyi// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pas dgyes tshims nas// 'jig rten khams kun bde zhing skyid pa dang*// sangs rgyas bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par mdzod// 'gal rkyen mi mthun phyogs kun zhi ba dang*// mthun rkyen yid la gang bsam 'grub par mdzod// thun mong mchog gi las dang dngos grub kun// thogs med myur du 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod// ces so// de nas las kyi rdo rjes tshogs dang*/

lha'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas longs spyad/ lhag ma bsdus la slob dpon gyi kha bshal ba'i chus bran/ oṃ badzra a ha ha ha utstshiṣṭa tre pa tre pi/ zhes byin brlab/ hūm̐/ chos nyid rnam dag zhi ba las// thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa byung*// thabs chen zla gsang thig le las// g.yar dam can rnams 'du bar mdzod// mkha' 'gro ging dang dbang phyug dang*// ma mo 'byung po sha za'i tshogs// gshin rje yi dwags ma lus kun// dpal gyi pham phab 'di bzhes la// zhi dang rgyas dang dbang la sogs// mngon spyod las rnams grub par mdzod// oṃ utstshiṣṭa ba liṃ ta bhakṣa si swā hā/ zhes brjod la dpal 'bar rol mo dang bcas phyi rol du dor ro// de nas rjes chog ni/ mchod pa zhal gsos la bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las ka pā la// yangs pa'i nang du hūm̐ yig las// mchod rdzas dwangs shing thogs med pa// kun bzang mchod sprin lta bur gyur// oṃ badzra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin dhū pe dang puṣpe nas shabda'i bar du sbyar bas brlab/ oṃ/ mchod yon bdug spos me tog snang gsal dri// zhal zas rol mo sha lnga rigs kyi yum// zag med bde chen bdud rtsi bde ba'i gnas// sha chen gsur dud zhun me dga' bde rgyas// snang ba sna tshogs lhan skyes ye shes bde// rang byung kun mkhyen ye shes mchod pa'i sprin// mchod par bzhes la dngos grub stsal du gsol// oṃ badzra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ de bzhin du dhū pe paṣpe sogs sbyar bas mchod la/ bstod par 'os pa thams cad la// zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyi// lus btud pa yis rnam kun tu// mchog tu gus pas phyag 'tshal bstod// nongs bshags ni yig brgya brjod/ bdag ni ma rig dbang gyur pas// legs byas 'di la nyes gyur gang*// cho ga lhag chad ci mchis pa// dkyil 'khor lha la bzod par gsol// ras bris sogs rten yod na/ oṃ/

'dir ni rten dang lhan cig tu// 'gro ba'i don du bzhugs nas kyang*// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// mchog rnams legs par stsal du gsol// oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzrā ye swā hā/ zhes me tog 'thor ba dang bcas mdun bskyed kyi ye shes pa brtan bzhugs bya/ dam tshig pa oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdag la bsdu/ rdul tshon nam rten med na/ mchod yon sbreng zhing dril bu gsil la yig brgya brjod cing*/ oṃ/ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas zhing du gshegs su gsol// sangs rgyas zhing du gshegs nas kyang*// sems can rnams kyi don slad du// slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol// oṃ badzra muḥ ye shes sems dpa' gshegs gyur nas// dam tshig pa rnams 'od du zhu// rang gi snying gar thim par gyur// a kā ro sogs brjod bzhin pas mchod gtor rnams bsal zhing sindhu ra'i dkyil 'khor mtha' nas bsdus la rim bzhin rang gi gnas gsum du thig le byas te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod/ lhag ma bdud rtsi dang bsres te ril bur byas la dam tshig gi rdzas su bzung zhing rdul tshon chu bor dor/ las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o// bkra shis ni/ slob dpon padma'i bkra shis shog /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i bkra shis shog /dpa' bo rgya mtsho'i bkra shis shog /dpa' mo rgya mtsho'i bkra shis shog /dam can rgya mtsho'i bkra shis shog /bsngo smon ni/ chos dbyings byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du// bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyis// dus gsum bsags dang rtogs pa yis// 'gro drug sems can ma lus kun// sku lnga yongs rdzogs sangs rgyas myur thob shog /ces sogs bsngo ba dang smon lam gdab bo// zhes pa 'di ni snang rtse nas sde pa rig 'dzin chen po'i nyams gzhes kyi ched du/ shākya'i dge slong dkon mchog 'bangs kyis/ dgon pa chen po mtshur phu'i bkra shis gsar steng du dpa' bo dga' ston gyi gral tshes la sbyar ba dge legs 'phel/

slar yang 'jam mgon bla ma karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtsho'i zhal snga nas brgyud pa'i kha skong sogs gsal byed gnang ba dkyus su bsdebs shing bklags pas grub par/ 'jig rten dbang phyug dpal karma pa chen po yab sras las tshul 'di'i bka' drin ched du nos pa'i bya bral ba 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos bris pa'i dge bas zab chos 'di nyid kyi phrin las mkha' khyab tu brtan cing*/ 'brel tshad 'gro kun bde ba can gyi zhing du skye ba'i rgyur gyur cig /sarba dā maṅga laṃ bha btu// ༈ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho lha lnga'i gtor dbang bklags chog tu bkod pa zab gsang dgongs 'dus zhes bya ba bzhugs so// bla ma dang bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten dbang phyug zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// srid pa'i 'jigs kun khyod mtshan gyis// bcom pas rtag tu mi mdza' yang*// 'khor ba pa rnams bu bzhin du// skyong mdzad snying rje'i gter la 'dud// smin byed 'o ma'i rgya mtsho'i bcud// grub pas myong ba 'di kho na// bskur thob spros pas tshol ba yi// byin rlabs chu brgya'i 'jug ngogs so// rgyal ba rgya mtsho lha lnga'i bskyed rdzogs grub pa'i rgyal mo nas brgyud pa bka' ma dang*/ mnga' bdag nyang rin po che las brgyud pa gter ma gnyis ka'i smin byed kyi rtsa ba gtor ma la brten pa'i byin rlabs byed par 'dod pas/ thod pa'am rin po che'i snod du dbus dang rgyab tu bla ma/ g.yas su yi dam/ g.yon du mkha' 'gro/ mdun du chos skyong pho rgyud kyi gtor ma bcas lnga tshar rgyan gyis mdzes pa mthong brgyud bzhin bcas la stegs bzang por khri'u'i steng du bkod pa'i mdun du mchod yon nyer spyod/ bdud rtsi'i thod pa/ tshogs kyi yo byad sogs bsham/ 'byor na lha lnga'i sku rten kyang bkram/ bdud rtsi byin rlabs nas bzung*/ rgya mtsho lha lnga'i bdag bskyed rdzogs par bsgom/ bzlas pa dang bsdu ldang bya/

mdun bskyed gtor ma bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyi gzhir// gtor ma sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga// ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin nyid// 'od zer las grub gzhal yas khang*// zhes sogs nas/ drang bstim mchod bstod bzlas pa yan chad grub pa dang*/ las bum yod tshe der skad cig gis rta mgrin dmar po g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon sdigs mdzub zhags pa bsnams pa gsal ba/ badzra kro dha'i sngags ci nus bzla/ slob ma rnams khrus byas/ gral du 'khod pa la slob dpon gyis/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bcom ldan 'jig rten dbang phyug gi go 'phang la 'god par bya/ de'i ched du smin byed zab mo gsan dgongs pa'i thugs bskyed gsal btab nas gsan 'tshal/ de'ang sgrub sde chen po brgyad las gsung padma zhi khro'i chos skor las zab pa dang rgya che ba'i smin grol gyi gzhung dang brgyud pa'i srol ka gnam gyi skar ma tsam gyi grub mtha' 'dzin pa kun la khyab cing brdal ba thams cad kyi nang nas nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor lta bu/ chos 'di kho nar grub pa'i rtags 'dzam gling khyab par ston pa'i brgyud pa da lta'i bar rgyun ma chad par byon pa sogs khyad par du mas 'phags pa dpal karma kaṃ tshang gi zab chos thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho 'di yin la/ 'di la'ang padma badzra nas brgyud/ dza landha ra'i rgya gzhung la brten pa lha dgu dang*/ rdo rje snying po'i rgya gzhung la brten cing grub pa'i rgyal mo las brgyud pa lha lnga dang*/ mnga' bdag nyang rin po che'i zab gter lha lnga'i skor sras 'gro mgon la brgyud pa thams cad gsang bdag ras chung pa chen po la 'dus shing*/ brgyud pa phyi ma rje don ldan zhabs la sangs rgyas gling pa'i thugs rje chen po'i chos skor yang 'du ba sogs bka' gter du ma'i dgongs bcud gcig tu 'bral zhing byin rlabs kyi tshan kha 'gran zla dang bral ba'i rgya mtsho lha lnga'i gtor dbang sgrub par byed pa la bdag nyid kyis bgyi bar 'os pa sngon du song*/

khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa zab mo gtor ma'i byin rlabs zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal 'bul 'tshal/ zhes mtshams sbyar la maṇḍal 'bul du gzhug dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang bla ma dbyer med pa'i drung du thal mo me tog dang bcas te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos// de bzhin bla ma dge 'dun te// bla ma rdo rje 'chang dbyer med// dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi// dam pas byin gyis brlab tu gsol// sku yi byin rlabs lus la stsol// lus la bde ba sbar du gsol// gsung gi byin rlabs ngag la stsol// ngag la nus pa bskyed du gsol// thugs kyi byin rlabs sems la stsol// mi rtog ye shes stsal du gsol// lan gsum/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor gtor ma 'di nyid dang tha mi dad par bcom ldan 'das rgyal ba rgya mtsho lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor 'di bzhin du bzhugs par mos mdzod/ 'od zer las grub gzhal yas khang*// zhes sogs nas/ gdan 'og padma 'degs pas bskyed/ de ltar dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i drung du yan lag bdun pa 'bul ba'i blos thal mo sbyar la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ phyogs bcu dus gsum bzhugs pa yi// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// bla ma rdo rje slob dpon la// yi dam lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas// thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol// 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas// tha ma da ltar thug gi bar// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gis// lus ngag yid gsum sgo nas ni// sdig pa dpag med bgyis pa dang*// bgyid du stsal dang yi rang ba// khyed kyi spyan sngar bshags par bgyi// slan chad bdag ni mi bgyid do// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// 'phags pa nyan thos rang rgyal gyi// yan lag rnams kyang gzung bar bgyi// 'gro ba kun gyi dge ba la// bdag ni rjes su yi rang ngo*// bde gshegs chos sku la bzhugs par// 'gro ba kun la phan don tu// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar ni// bdag ni rtag tu gsol ba 'debs// bde gshegs mdzad pa mthar phyin nas// mya ngan 'da' bar bzhed rnams la// bskal pa'i tha mar bzhugs par ni// bdag ni rtag tu gsol ba 'debs// bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba gang*// bgyis sam bgyid du stsal ba dang*// rjes su yi rang thams cad ni// 'gro ba kun gyis thob par shog

/spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje'i bdag /bla mar bcas pa thams cad la// bdag gi lus 'di phul ba yis// theg pa dman la mi 'jug cing*// theg chen bla na med pa'i lam// zab cing rgya che bstan du gsol// lan gsum/ slar yang khyad par gyi gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ padma dbang gi dkyil 'khor du// mgon po gzi brjid 'od dpag med// rgyal sras tshogs dang bcas pa la// dbang bskur yongs su rdzogs pa ltar// de bzhin bla ma khyed kyis kyang*// bdag la dbang bskur mdzad du gsol// lan gsum/ de ltar gsol ba btab pas dbus phyogs chos sku rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs kyi smin mtshams nas lha tshogs dpag tu med pa nas 'bru tsam yungs 'bru tsam 'od zer dmar po'i tshogs dang bcas pa lus la thim pas nad gdon sdig sgrib sang sang dag chos sku rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i rnam par lam lam gyur/ sku mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i dbang thob/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i mgrin pa nas ā li kā li dang 'od zer dmar po 'phros/ mgrin par thim pas ngag gi sdig sgrib sang gis dag gsung mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i dbang thob/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs kyi thugs ka nas bdud rtsi byang sems kyi chu rgyun dkar dmar na ra ra byung*/ snying gar thim pas sems kyi sgrib pa thams cad 'o mas sol khu ded pa bzhin nag nu ru ru rkang pa'i sor mo rnams nas thon/ shul thams cad ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang*/ bde stong gi sems rgyud la skyes nas thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i dbang thob/ gzhan yang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad chos sku rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i ngo bor gyur nas nam mkha' gang snyed kyi ḍā ma ru dang dril bu la sogs pa 'ur 'ur khrol khrol gar stabs kyis byon nas/ lus ngag yid gsum la sib sib thim pas nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad sang gis dag par sgoms shig

gtor ma gnas gsum du bzhag yig bcu'i gsham du/ ā be sha ya ā be sha ya a ā/ zhes btags pa drag tu brjod cing spos dang rol mo bya/ des gzhan bzhi po la 'gre ste/ slar yid kyis gsol ba btab pas/ g.yas phyogs rta mgrin dpa' bo rgya mtsho'i smin mtshams nas sogs gong gi tshig kha bsgyur ba'i mthar/ badzra kro dha'i sngags la ā be sha ya btags pas dbang bskur/ slar yid kyis gsol ba btab pas/ g.yon phyogs gsang ye dpa' mo rgya mtsho'i smin mtshams sogs dang*/ dhu ma gha ya'i sngags la sham bu btags pas dbang bskur/ slar yid kyis gsol ba btab pas/ steng phyogs pad 'byung grub thob rgya mtsho'i smin mtshams sogs dang*/ badzra gu ru'i sngags sham bu can gyis dbang bskur/ slar yid kyis gsol ba btab pas/ 'og phyogs ma mgon dam can rgya mtsho'i smin mtshams sogs dang*/ oṃ ma hā kā lā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ trag rakṣa ma hi dun bhyo ma hā yakṣa tikṣa kā li du na bhyo/ zhes ma mgon sngags ā be sha'i sham bu can gyis dbang bskur/ slar yid kyis gsol 'debs drag tu byas pas/ lha tshogs de rnams kyi smin mtshams dang mgul dang thugs ka dang lte ba la sogs pa'i sku'i gnas rnams nas 'od zer bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung*/ rang gi lus kyi gnas so sor thim pas nad gdon sdig sgrib sogs bar du gcod pa thams cad ni bsal/ tshe dang dpal dang 'byor pa thams cad ni shin tu rgyas/ dbang bzhi thob cing sku bzhi mngon du byed pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur/ ces gtor ma mgo bor bkod/ rol mo dbyangs dang bcas pas/ hūm̐/ lho nub srin po'i grong khyer nas// zhes sogs spyan 'dren gyi tshogs bcad kyi mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ oṃ dhu ma gha ye na maḥswā hā/ ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya/ ā be sha ya ā be sha ya a ā/ zhes yun ring du brjod/ de ltar byin rlabs zab mo byas pas ye shes lus la babs pas 'phar zhing 'dar/

ngag la babs pas saṃ skṛ ta'i skad 'don/ yid la babs pas rnam par mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin rgyud la skyes bar gsungs pas de dag rdo rje ye shes phebs pa'i rtags su nges shes skyed la yid la mi byed pa'i ngang du mnyam par zhog mdzod/ de lta bu'i dbang gi ye shes brtan pa'i slad du rgya mtsho lnga'i lha tshogs rnams kyis mgrin gcig tu shis brjod stsal ba'i mos pa mdzod/ chos dbyings lhun gyis grub pa la// dbyer med 'khor 'das yongs su rdzogs// dus gsum sangs rgyas skyed pa'i yum// chos sku mchog gi bkra shis shog /rnam snang ye shes gangs chen mtsho// mi 'khrugs rgyal po la sogs pa'i// rgyal ba sras bcas 'khor gyis bskor// longs spyod rdzogs pa'i bkra shis shog /thub chen rgyal ba gser mdog can// bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong gi dbus// rnam 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pa// sprul sku mchog gi bkra shis shog /sku gsum lhun grub yongs rdzogs shing*// ye shes dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor du// ngo bo nyid kyis thams cad mkhyen// sku bzhi yongs rdzogs bkra shis shog /sems dpa' rang byung rdo rje ni// yid bzhin nor bu rnyed pa ltar// bdag gzhan yongs kyi dbul ba sel// dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i bkra shis shog /byang chub sems kyi phrin las kyis// thugs rje'i 'od zer phyogs med 'phro// bco lnga'i zla ba nya rgyas ltar// 'dzam gling 'jig rten bkra shis shog /ces shis pa brjod/ khyed cag gis bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten dbang phyug rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor du gtor ma la brten pa'i dbang thob pa yin pas/ rdo rje theg pa'i dam tshig la bslab bo snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs dang*/ gtang rag maṇḍal/ lus longs spyod 'bul ba/ dge bsngo spyi ltar byas la slob ma rnams gyes/ tshogs nas brtsam/ rjes chog rnams kyi mthar/

a kā ro sogs brjod cing gtor ma gshegs la dngos grub kyi tshul du slob ma rnams la byin nas bkra shis brjod par bya'o// gtor dbang gi yi ge don ldan zhabs/ karma dkon gzhon/ dkon mchog yan lag gis mdzad pa rnams kyi rtsa ba ni thams cad mkhyen pa rang byung zhabs kyis mdzad pa 'di yin cing*/ thams cad kyang tshig rgyas bsdus tsam las sngags dmigs kyi don ni mtshungs pa kho na yin la/ da lta dkon mchog 'bangs kyis mdzad pa las rgyun gnang rung*/ cung zad bsdus ches pas blo dman rang 'dra rnams kyis shin tu gal che ba'i byin rlabs dmigs rnam brda mi 'phrod par mun pa'i klong du 'khyams par mthong nas rtsa ba rang byung zhabs kyi gzhung gab sprad de gsal bar bkod pa'o// ba mkhal mar grags gzhung gnyis kyi// thun min smin byed zab rgya can// gsal bar bkod 'dir 'brel thogs kun// 'jig rten mgon pos rjes 'dzin shog /ces pa'ang gar dbang lnga pas mdzad pa'i lha lnga'i sgrub dkyil tshigs bcad ma dang 'brel bar rang gzhan la nyer mkho'i btsas su padma gar dbang blo gros mtha' yas kyis dben pa zla mdzes su bris pa dge legs 'phel// ༈ /thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho lha lnga gzhung rkyang lugs su nyams su len pa'i zin bris padma'i lcug ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru lo ke shwa rā ya/ rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor kun 'dus pa// rgya mtsho lnga yi lha tshogs la// btud nas bsnyen cing sgrub pa'i tshul// rtsa ba'i dgongs don snying po dril// sgrub brgyud karma kaṃ tshang la bka' babs pa'i zab chos nor bu'i gram bur brdal ba'i yang gces mkha' 'gro'i srog tig gi sde tshan bka' gter chu bo bzhi 'dus rgyal ba rgya mtsho lha lnga zhes zab par grags shing byin rlabs kyi gzi byin dang ldan pa 'di nyid nyams su len tshul sba lcag ma dang*/ ba mkhal ma'i lugs gnyis su grags shing phyi ma snga ma'i las tshogs lta bur 'gyur ba'i phyir nyams su len bya'i rtsa ba ni sba lcag ma nyid yin la/

de'i gdams ngag grub chen pakṣi'i gzhung bla ma gnyan ras kyi zin bris bcas pa dang*/ rtogs ldan mkha' spyod dbang po'i gsung la chos rje de bzhin gshegs pas zin bris su mdzad pa dang*/ mtshur phu 'jam dbyangs chen pos rgyud gzhung gi dgongs pa rtsal du bton pa'i lugs gsum ni rtsa ba ste/ de dag gang la zhugs kyang mchog thun gyi grub 'bras mi slu bas khyad par ma mchis la/ phyis su grub brnyes chags med zhabs kyi zin bris che chung rnams ni mkha' spyod pa'i bzhed gzhung la grub chen chos kyi bla ma'i gdams ngag dang nyang dang sangs gling sogs kyi gter kha'i zab gnad kyang ci rigs pas rgyan par snang la/ de dag las dmigs pa lag len rgyas pa'i rigs rnams blo dman dang 'byor pa chung bas lag tu mi lon cing*/ gsang sgrub 'khor lo gcig ma sogs zab gnad thun mong ma yin pa'i skor rnams zab dbang sngon tu song ba'i brgyud 'dzin las khrom chos su spel bar bya ba ma yin pas/ 'dir rje dkon mchog yan lag gis mdzad pa'i lha lnga'i sgrub thabs tshigs bcad ma dang 'brel bar gtor dbang gi byin rlabs tsam nos pa'i gang zag gis 'brel 'jog lta bur nyams su len pa'i tshul la/ gzhung las/ phyi ltar rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs// ma lus phyi ru sgom pa dang*// nang ltar lus la 'god pa dang*// gsang ba rtsa la dgod pa dang*// yang gsang de nyid sems la 'god// ces gsungs pa ltar bzhi/ phyi dkyil bsnyen pa'i rnal 'byor/ nang lus dkyil sgrub pa'i rim pa/ gsang ba rtsa dkyil las sbyor gyi tshul/ yang gsang sems dkyil snga ma gsum gyi grub mtha' lam du slong ba'o// dang po ni/ gzhung las/ de ltar phyi sgrub bsnyen pa la// dkyil 'khor bca' gzhi mi dgos shing*// rgyun du yi dam nar mar bya// zhes gsungs pas dkyil 'khor sogs bsham bkod kyi spros pa mi dgos/ 'bul gtor lnga tshar mdun du/

mchod yon sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod phreng tshar du bsham/ bdud rtsi thod zhal/ sngon gtor/ tshogs kyi yo byad rnams 'du bya/ yar mar gyi tshes brgyad dgongs mo dbang gi dus su dbu brtsams te/ gnas spyi gtsug pad zla'i gdan steng na// sems dpa' rang byung rdo rje la// bka' brgyud bla ma'i tshogs kyis bskor// bdag mos gus gdung bas gsol ba 'debs// snang srid byin gyis rlob tu gsol// dbus mi 'gyur rdo rje'i gdan steng na// bcom ldan thugs rje chen po la// rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bskor// bdag mos gus gdung bas gsol ba 'debs// snang srid byin gyis rlob tu gsol// g.yas me dpung 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na// khro bo'i rgyal po rta mchog la// dpa' bo rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bskor// bdag mos gus gdung bas gsol ba 'debs// snang srid byin gyis rlob tu gsol// g.yon mkha' spyod dag pa'i gzhal yas na// yum gsang ba ye shes ḍā ki la// mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bskor// bdag mos gus gdung bas gsol ba 'debs// snang srid byin gyis rlob tu gsol// steng dag pa lha yi gzhal yas na// slob dpon padma 'byung gnas la// grub thob rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bskor// bdag mos gus gdung bas gsol ba 'debs// snang srid byin gyis rlob tu gsol// 'og dam tshig chen po'i gzhal yas na// chos skyong ma mgon lcam dral la// dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bskor// bdag mos gus gdung bas gsol ba 'debs// snang srid byin gyis rlob tu gsol// rtsa ba brgyud par bcas rnams la// dad cing gus pas gsol btab pas// bdag dang 'gro drug sems can rnams// rnam pa kun mkhyen thob par shog /sems dpa' rang byung rdo rje ni// yid bzhin nor bu rnyed pa ltar// bdag gzhan yongs kyi dbul ba sel// dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i bkra shis shog

/byang chub sems kyi phrin las kyis// thugs rje'i 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phro// bco lnga'i zla ba nya rgyas ltar// 'dzam gling bde ba'i bkra shis shog /'dzam gling bde bar mdzad du gsol// ces snang srid byin rlob ma'i gsol 'debs dang*/ rang nyid thugs rje chen por gsal bas nang mchod byin rlabs byas la lcer myang*/ skad cig gis khro rgyal rta mgrin du gsal bas bgegs gtor bsngos/ sku las ye shes kyi me 'bar/ bgegs lhag ma rnams bskrad/ me'i rwa gur du gyur/ slar yang phyag mtshan mtshon cha'i tshogs spros/ rdo rje la sogs pa'i rwa gur ru gyur/ slar khro tshogs du ma spros pas 'ga' zhig zhal phyir gzigs zlog pa'i las mdzad/ la la nang du gzigs/ srung ba'i las mdzad par bsgom/ mchod pa byin rlabs dang*/ skyabs sems nyer gcig gam gsum la sogs pa'i mthar spro na rdor sems sgom bzlas ma rgyud spyi ltar bya/ tshogs bsags/ gsol 'debs/ tshad med bzhi bsgoms la tshogs zhing rang la bstim pa rnams ni sngon du 'gro ba'o// dngos gzhi bskyed bzlas gnyis las bskyed chog yan lag bzhi rdzogs ni/ stong pa'i ngang las bde ba can lta bu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing bkod pa phul du phyin pa'i dbus su mtshan nyid rdzogs pa'i gzhal yas khang gi nang du rin po che'i padma'i sdong bu kha gsum du gyes pa'i dbus mar thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho/ g.yas rta mgrin dpa' bo rgya mtsho/ g.yon gsang ye mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho/ steng gi bar snang du slob dpon padma grub thob rgya mtsho/ gdan 'og tu ma mgon dam can rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor te rgya mtsho lnga'i dkyil 'khor pa thams cad kyi gnas gsum byin gyis brlab/ ye shes pa gzhug dbang bskur/ rang rigs gtso bor gyur pas rgyas gdab/ de nas bzlas pa ni/ rgya mtsho lnga'i dkyil 'khor pa thams cad kyi thugs kar pad nyi zla ba'i gdan la hrīḥyig dmar po re re'i mthar/

gtso bo la yig bcu/ rta mgrin dang gsang ye la rang sngags/ slob dpon padma la badzra gu ru/ chos skyong ma mgon la rang sngags/ gsang ye la sngags ngo nang bstan g.yon tu 'khor zhing*/ gzhan rnams la phyir bstan g.yas su 'khor bar mos/ sngags bzlas pas sngags phreng sa bon dang bcas pa las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa mchod/ thugs rgyud mnyes/ byin rlabs dang dngos grub thams cad 'od zer sna lnga'i rnam par byon/ rang la thim pas thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib las nyon bag chags dang bcas pa sang gis dag bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs rdzogs/ bum gsang sher ye tshogs gi dbang bzhi thob pas rgyud smin/ slar 'od zer 'phros/ khams gsum gyi sems can rnams la phog pas sdig sgrib thams cad skad cig la byang*/ phyi snod padma dbang gi dkyil 'khor/ nang bcud pho thams cad spyan ras gzigs/ mo thams cad gsang ba ye shes/ bdud dang log 'dren thams cad rta mgrin dbang chen/ phyogs dang mtshams rnams 'ja' 'od me dpung thig les shig shig tu gang*/ mdor na gzugs snang thams cad rgya mtsho lnga'i lha tshogs kyi rang bzhin/ sgra grags thams cad yi ge bcu pa'i rang sgra/ dran rtogs thams cad chos sku gnyug ma phyag rgya chen po'i rang bab tu mos la/ rigs dang mthun pa'i bgrang phreng byin gyis brlabs pa thogs te yi ge bcu pa la bzlas pa dngos gzhi bya/ thun mthar sngags gzhan gsum po'ang sham bur sbyar te bdun re tsam bzla'o// rjes rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom pa ni/ thun 'jog pa na/ rang gi thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros phyi snod gzhal yas khang nang bcud lha la thim/ de 'od du zhu 'khor rnams la thim/ de rnams bdag bdag nyid kyang 'od du zhu nas thugs ka'i hrīḥl thim/ de mas rim gyis zhu ste nā dar thim/ de'ang stong nyid du yal/ bsgom med yengs med spros bral phyag rgya chen po'i rang ngo la ci gnas su mnyam par bzhag

mthar zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i spyan ras gzigs su ldangs la/ khyer so gsum gyi rnal 'byor dang ldan pas dge ba bsngo zhing spyod lam thams cad tshogs kyi lam du khyer bar bya'o// yang skabs rer ting nge 'dzin gyi khyad par 'di ltar yang bya ste/ bdag nyid kyis sngags bzlas pa ltar/ g.yas g.yon steng 'og gi lha tshogs rnams kyis kyang 'ur dir bzlas pa dang chabs cig sku las 'od zer mu med pa 'phros/ sems can thams cad la phog 'jig rten dbang phyug gi go 'phang la bkod/ nyan rang rnams la phog theg chen gyi lam la bkod/ byang sems rnams la phog thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang la bkod/ sangs rgyas rnams la phog chos gsung ba dang sems can gyi don la bskul bar bsgom mo// bsnyen pa'i tshad ni dus zhag bdun nam nyer gcig grangs yig bcu 'bum ther gsum mam bcu/ bsnyen tshad song nas rta mgrin sogs sham bur sgyur nas bzla ste grangs tshad gsal kha ma gsungs so// gal te sgrub mchod dang gtor dbang byed par spro na sngar bshams pa'i gtor ma la dmigs rten byas nas mdun bskyed yan lag bzhi rdzogs mchod bstod bdud rtsi phul ba'i mthar/ bzlas pa'i skabs su bdag mdun rnams kyi thugs srog sngags phreng bcas sngar ltar gsal/ bdag gi thugs ka nas 'od zer rtsa ba gcig la rtse mo lnga'i rnam par 'phros/ mdun bskyed lha lnga so so'i thugs kar thim/ de dag gi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi byin rlabs thams cad 'od kyi rnam par bsdus nas rang gi thugs kar thim par bsgom/ tshogs mchod sogs rjes kyi bya ba rnams gzhung gsal ltar byas pas 'grub/ bsnyen pa tshugs pa'i nub thog ma dang*/ dus bzang rnams su tshogs mchod bya ba'i tshe gong smos mdun bskyed nyid grub na legs la/ ma grub na bdag bskyed bsdu ldangs mthar tshogs byin brlab/ tshogs mgron nam mkhar spyan drang*/ tshogs dang gtor ma gnyis ka bdud rtsir brlabs te phul la tshogs rdzas dngos grub tu rol/

lhag ma dang rjes chog gzhung gsal ltar la spyan drangs pa'i ye shes pa rnams sku rten sogs yod na rten bzhugs bya/ med na gshegs su gsol la bsngo smon bkra shis rnams bya'o// 'di kho nas kyang 'brel 'jog tsam gyi bsnyen pa ni grub pa yin no// gnyis pa ni/ dkyil 'khor bca' gzhi mngon rtogs kyi dbur gsal ba ltar bkod/ yar mar tshes bcu gang rung gi dus su sngon dngos kyi bya ba rnams phyi sgrub ji lta ba bzhin las bskyed rim gyi khyad par rang nyid rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i thugs kar pad nyi bdud bzhi'i gdan la rta mgrin dmar nag khro tshul dur khrod chas kyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas dbang sdud phyag rgyas padma dmar po'i phreng ba 'dren cing*/ g.yon utpal dmar po'i zhags pa sdigs mdzub dang bcas te dkur brten pa/ dbu gtsug rta mgo ljang zhur rta skad mtsher bas srid gsum g.yo ba/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ba'i thugs kar pad nyi la hrīḥdamar sngags phreng g.yas su 'khor ba/ lte bar padma'i ze'u 'brur gser gyi rdo rje rgya gram gyi lte dbus su chos byung bsnol ma zur drug dga' 'khyil dang bcas pa'i dbus su pad nyi ro'i steng du gsang ba ye shes/ gsang bar padma 'dab bzhir rigs bzhi'i mkha' 'gro yab yum dkar ser dmar ljang gri thod 'dzin pas rnal 'byor ma'i gdan 'degs pa'i tshul can/ mgrin pa'i pad zla la spyan ras gzigs dmar po bgrang phreng dang padma 'dzin pas bzhengs stabs/ spyi bor slob dpon padma'am sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas bka' brgyud bla ma'i tshogs bcas gsal btab la yan lag bzhi rdzogs gzhung ltar bya/ de'ang mngon rtogs kyi gtso bo'i bskyed chog grub pa'i mtshams su lus dkyil 'di bzhin gsal btab la gnas gsum byin rlabs sogs la 'jug mkha' spyod pa'i bzhed par phyi dkyil yang bkod pa yin kyang gzhung don snying po 'di nyid ngo mtshar che'o// 'dir spyi mgrin gyi lha 'god tshul yang gang de'i bzhed pa yin kyang bsdu na mgrin pa'i lha mi bkod/

bla ma rig bdag gi tshul du bsgoms pas chog bzlas pa ni nus na rlung bum pa can dang sbyar nas rlung sngags dbyer mi phyed pa'i bzlas pa la gtso bor bya/ mi nus na gzhung las/ rlung bzung sngags bzla gang goms bya// zhes 'byung bas bar rlung tsam la brten te ngag bzlas byas kyang chog pa ni gsang sgrub la'ang shes par bya'o// ting nge 'dzin ni lte 'og tu gtum mo a shad dam thig le me'i rang bzhin dmar zhing 'tsher ba gsal gdab/ rlung phyir 'gro ba'i tshe snying ga'i sa bon sngags phreng gtum mo'i me dang bcas pa'i 'od zer gyis brtan g.yo snod bcud 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin tu bzhus/ rlung nang du 'ong ba'i tshe de dag sna bug gnyis nas brgyud de lte ba'i me la thim pas sdong rtsa mar khus brlan pa bzhin tu gtum mo'i me lce har gyis 'bar bas bde chen gyi ye shes skyes par mos la stong nyid kyi ngang du bzhag yang 'od zer sngar bzhin 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ byang sems su zhu ba me la thim/ dbang dang byin rlabs thob cing bde chen skyes/ yang 'od zer 'phros/ 'gro ba drug la phog byams pa dang snying rje drag tu bskyed pas de dag byang sems su zhu/ snying rje'i ngang du rlung rngubs pas me la thim par mos la stong nyid du bzhag mthar lus dkyil gyi lha rnams rang gnas su 'od du yal nas mkha' la sprin dengs pa ltar mi dmigs pa'i ngang nas rlung bzlas bya/ bzla bya dngos gzhi yi ge bcu pa/ grangs sngar dang 'dra/ rtags mthong nas sngags yongs rdzogs sbrel la bzla gsungs kyang da lta'i phyag len tu rta sngags mi sbrel bar 'dug bdag mdun sgom tshul rnying ma spyi mtshungs bya chog kyang phyag rgyun du thun stod bdag bskyed thun smad mdun bskyed mchod bstod sogs spros pa che bar mdzad par snang*/ sgrub pa rdzogs pa'i mjug tu dngos gzhi'i bzlas sgom rnams khyug tsam re byas la/

snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer lcags kyu'i dbyibs can me 'od ltar rno zhing tsha la gdung ba phrom phrom shar shar du 'phros pas snod bcud kyi dwangs ma spyi dang*/ dmigs bsal yid la 'dod pa'i dngos po dbang du bsdus nas snying ga'i sa bon dang thod pa'i rdzas la thim par mos la/ sngags rnams sbrel ba'i sham du/ ba su siddhi nā nā kha dhe siddhi sarba siddhi pha la hūm̐/ siddhi siddhi sa ma ya sdus sdus hūm̐ hūm̐ puṣṭiṃ bā shaṃ ku ru hūm̐/ ratna siddhi sa ma ya hrīṃ hrīṃ dzaḥdzaḥ zhes btags pa ji tsam 'os pa bzla'o// gsum pa ni/ bca' gzhi nang sgrub ltar bya/ bskyed rim gyi skabs su/ sngon 'gro'i chos rnams song ba'i mtshams su/ oṃ mahā shū n+ya tā sogs brjod/ gzung 'dzin chos rnams stong par gyur// stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi dang*// zla ba'i gdan la rang sems hrīḥ /yongs gyur padma hrīḥyig mtshan// 'od 'phros 'gro ba'i rgyud sbyangs shing*// rgyal ba'i byin rlabs bsdus nas thim// de las bdag nyid spyan ras gzigs// zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dmar// g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum gar gyis bsgyings// dbu skra gyen brdzes dar gyis brgyan// rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes par spras// phyag g.yas pad phreng g.yon padma// gsang ba ye shes yum gyis 'khyud// dmar mo gcer bu spyan gsum pa// phyag g.yas gri gug g.yon thod khrag /thod pa skam po rus rgyan can// rin chen sna tshogs dar dpyangs brgyan// ye shes me ri'i dbus na bzhugs// yab kyi sku la rtsa gsum dang*// 'khor lo lnga po gsal ba yi// spyi bor bde gshegs spyan ras gzigs// dkar po 'khor lo dril bu can// rtsa 'dab mkha' 'gro sum cu gnyis// 'khor lo gri gug thod khrag 'dzin// mgrin par padma'i spyan ras gzigs// dmar po padma dril bu can// rtsa 'dab mkha' 'gro bcu drug ni// padma gri gug thod khrag 'dzin// snying gar rdo rje spyan ras gzigs// mthing ga rdo rje dril bu can// rtsa 'dab rdo rje mkha' 'gro brgyad// rdo rje gri gug thod khrag 'dzin// lte bar rin chen spyan ras gzigs// ser po rin chen dril bu can// rtsa 'dab mkha' 'gro drug cu bzhi// rin chen gri gug thod khrag 'dzin// gsang bar las kyi spyan ras gzigs// ljang gu rgya gram dril bu can// rtsa 'dab las kyi mkha' 'gro bzhi// rgya gram gri gug thod khrag thogs// kun kyang rin chen rus pas brgyan// yab rnams thugs kar rta mgrin dang*// yum rnams thugs kar phag mo gsal// rang gi spyi bor bla ma dang*// lte bar dpa' bo ging chen bzhi// gsang ye'i spyi bor na bza' dkar// lte bar rigs bzhi'i mkha' 'gro ma// kun kyang thod pa skam rlon dang*// rin chen rus rgyan dar gyis mdzes// padma nyi zla ro gdan can// me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus su 'gying*// de dag ma lus thams cad kyi// spyi bor zla steng sogs gnas gsum byin rlabs nas dbang bskur rgyas gdab par dkyus bzhin bya'o// bzlas pa'i skabs/

'dom bar du yam̐ las rlung dkyil ljang gu yi ges mtshan pa yang zhing g.yo ba/ lte 'og dbu ma'i nang du a thung dmar po mtshan nyid bzhi ldan/ spyi gtsug dbu ma'i yar sner ham̐ yig dkar po 'khyil zhing 'dzag la khad pa rnams gsal btab la rlung ro dgu phrugs su 'bud/ steng 'og gi rlung kha sbyor ba'i rkyen gyis rlung dkyil g.yos/ gsang gnas kyi 'khor lo'i lha rnams bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin tu 'bar/ des gtum mo'i me sbar/ des lte ba'i 'khor lo'i lha rnams bde chen tu 'bar ba sogs rim bzhin spyi bo'i bar du 'bar bas ham̐ yig bzhus/ de las byang chub sems kyi rgyun babs pas spyi bo'i rtsa 'khor gang*/ dga' ba'i ye shes skyes par mos la rlung bzung zhing yid bzlas bya/ de bzhin du byang sems babs pas mgrin pa'i rtsa 'khor gang*/ mchog dga' skyes/ snying ga gang*/ khyad dga' skyes/ lte ba gang*/ lhan skyes dga' ba la sems bzung zhing yid bzlas so sor bya/ de nas rlung phyir bsal ba'i tshe thugs srog hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros/ rgyal ba sras bcas/ 'gro ba rigs drug sogs 'khor 'das phyi nang snod bcud thams cad rlung nang du rngubs pa dang dbyer med du bsdus/ dngos 'dzin 'khrul rtog gi bag chags thams cad bde chen 'bar ba'i mes bsregs/ rlung sems ye shes chen po'i rang bzhin dwangs ma'i thig ler thim/ stong nyid snying rje dbyer med tha mal shes pa ma bcos gnyug ma khyab brdal chen po phyogs med ris med kyi rtsal chen sbyong la bzlas pa bya/ mdun rten la'ang rang nyid ji lta bar bskyed cing spro bsdu bya/ thun mthar bdag mdun thugs ka'i 'od zer lcags kyu'i dbyibs can tsha la gdung bas skye 'gro pho mo'i snying ga dang gsang gnas nas bzung ste rang dbang med par mdun tu bkug slar yang 'od zer gyis gdungs pas mar gsar nyi mas bzhu ba bzhin de dag byang sems dkar dmar gyi ngo bor zhu ba sgrub rdzas dang rang gi gsang ba'i lam nas drangs thugs srog hrīḥl thim par mos la byams snying rje drag tu bsgom/

bzla bya'i sngags sham bu bcas kyi grangs/ dus/ zlo tshul sogs gong dang mtshungs/ 'dir thun mong gi las gtso bor sgrub na sba lcag dang ba mkhal sogs kyi bca' gzhi dgos kyang mchog sgrub la de dag med kyang chog pas 'jug pa bde ba gtsor bton pa yin no// sgrub pa de nyid grub ma thag par mar khu yam shing*/ rin chen zas nor gos dang 'bru sna shing tog sogs gang 'byor la snang ba dbang sdud kyi sbyin sreg spros med lugs spyi ltar bya'o// bzhi pa ni/ lus gzhal yas khang*/ sems nyid kyi ngo bo bla ma/ gti mug spyan ras gzigs/ rtog tshogs sangs rgyas stong rtsa/ zhe sdang rta mgrin/ 'dod chags gsang ye/ nga rgyal dpa' bo/ phrag dog dpa' mo/ khams lnga rigs lnga'i mkha' 'gro/ tshogs drug yul dang bcas pa mchod pa'i lha mo/ dge sdig gi rtog pa dam can srung ma ste/ de dag ma rtogs pas 'khor ba'i rnam pa/ rang bzhin rtogs pas myang 'das kyi ngo bo/ lha sku sems kyi rang rtsal/ sgra grags stong brjod med/ rig pa gdod nas spros bral chos sku/ yul dang yul can las 'das pa'i gnas lugs gnyug ma'i don la blo rang bab tu gnas pas sgom bzlas thams cad mthar thug gi lam du bslang bar bya'o// gzhan yang grub chen karma pa'i gdams ngag bsre ba skor gsum zhes lha dgu lha lnga bsnyen sgrub spyi'i zab gnad 'di ltar gsungs te/ rlung ro drag tu 'bud/ me las 'od 'phros/ rgyal ba sras bcas kyi sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs bsdus/ lte ba'i me dang thugs ka'i hrīḥl thim/ lus kyi nang mes gang*/ mos gus drag tu bya/ nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad bsregs par bsgom/ mthar gnyis med phyag rgya chen po'i ngang du bzhag pa ni longs skur bsre ba'o// yang res 'ga' gzhan dbang du bya 'dod pa'am/ yid yul du sdug cing chags pa'am/ snying rje ba'am/ zhe sdang ba sogs gang byung yang rang nyid sku mdog dmar ba las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros/

dmigs yul gyis gtsor byas pa'i sems can thams cad bkug byams snying rje drag tu bsgom/ lte ba'i me dang thugs ka'i hrīḥl thim/ mthar mi dmigs pa'i ngang du bzhag pa ni sprul skur bsre ba'o// de nas lus btang snyoms skyil krung mnyam bzhag ngag btang snyoms smra brjod bral ba/ sems btang snyoms phyag rgya chen po'i ngang la bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang lha sku snang la rang bzhin med par bsgom/ phyi snang ba rgya yan/ nang rig pa rang grol/ lus ye shes kyi lus/ rtsa ye shes kyi rtsa/ rlung ye shes kyi rlung*/ de nyid kyi ngang las glo bur gyi rnam rtog dkar nag gang skyes kyang skyes pa'i ngo bo la cer gyis bltas pas rtog pa de rang skye med rtsa bral/ 'gag pa med pa/ dmigs gtad bral ba lhang lhang 'char ro// 'di ni chos sku dang bsre ba mchog gi gtum mo zhes bya'o// zhes gsungs pa nyid rgyun gyi nyams su blang bya'i snying po'o// sgrub pa snga rjes kyi bar du mchod gtor kha gso ba'am/ yun ring na brje ba dang*/ nang gsang sgrub pa la dgongs mo'i thun thams cad du tshogs mchod grub na legs shing ma grub na sgrub pa gang yin grub pa'i mjug tu tshogs gtor rgyas pa bya/ grol khar gtor dbang tsam la brten pa'i dngos grub blang chog dang mtha' rgyas sogs mtshams kyi khrigs dang spang blang spyi ltar la/ 'di nyid mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i srog snying shin tu gnyan pa'i gnad kyis nang gsang sgrub pa la zhugs khar dam tshig sel spyod dang mkha' 'gro chos srung la tshogs gtor/ mtshams 'og tu dam sel can gyi 'grul mi bya ba sogs dkyus las dam tsam bya ba gal che'o// 'khrul blos nyes byas rgya mtsho lnga yi lhas// tshangs par bzhes la 'brel bcas rnal 'byor kun// padma rnam par rgyas pa'i dkyil 'khor du// mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo lnga 'grub shog /ces pa 'di'ang khyab bdag 'jig rten dbang phyug kun mkhyen bla ma'i bka' yis rjes su gnang ba ltar/
