spyan ras gzigs dbang karma pa'i chos rigs su skyes pa blo gros mtha' yas kyis gzhung dang yig rnying gter kha rnams kyi dgongs pa gung spros te sbyar ba dge legs 'phel// ༈ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho lha lnga'i rgyun khyer 'khor lo gsum pa padma'i snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs so// padma rnam par rgyas pa'i lha// rgya mtsho lnga la gus btud de// yang zab rgyun gyi rnal 'byor ni// 'khor lo gsum dril gdams pa 'chad// thog mar skyabs su 'gro ba ni// bdag sogs mkha' mnyam sems can kun// dus 'di nas bzung byang chub bar// bla ma yi dam dkon mchog la// sgo gsum gus pas skyabs su mchi// sems bskyed pa ni// nam mkha' dang mnyam sems can kun// bde ldan sdug bsngal dang bral zhing*// spyan ras gzigs kyi go 'phang slad// rim gnyis zab mo bsgom par bya// bskyed pa'i rim pa lus lha'i 'khor lo la brten pa ni/ rang gi snying dbus hrīḥyig dmar// 'od 'phros bdag lus 'od du zhu// thugs rje chen po'i sku ru gyur// dmar gsal zhal gcig zhi zhing 'dzum// phyag bzhi'i dang po thal mo sbyar// mtha' gnyis pad phreng padma dmar// dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis spras// skyil krung padma'i gdan la bzhugs// dbu gtsug snang ba mtha' yas dmar// mnyam bzhag sprul pa sku yi chas// thugs kar rta mchog ye shes sems// dmar po pad phreng dbang sdud rgya// brkyang bskum zhi ma khro yi tshul// pad nyi me dpung klong du gsal// thug srog hrīḥyig dmar pos mtshan// lte bar gsang ba ye shes dmar// khro 'dzum chags nyams rus rgyan can// phyag bzhis gri thod ral gri dang*// kha ṭwāṃ ga 'dzin brkyang bskum zhabs// padma'i gdan la rigs bzhi la// mkha' 'gros btegs shing gtso bo la// bde ba'i longs spyod 'bul bar mdzad// dam ye dbyer med gdod ma nas// rang byung lhun grub chen po'o// bzlas pa'i rim pa ngag sngags kyi 'khor lo la brten pa ni/

rang gi zhal nas sngags bzlas pas// mkha' 'gros sngags sgrog 'od dmar gyis// snying ga'i lha bskul bzlas pa dang*// 'od kyis spyi bo'i rigs bdag bskul// nges kyang sngags bzlas 'od dmar 'phros// rgyal rnams sems can don la bskul// byang sems shes sgrib phra mo sbyangs// rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin bskyed// nyan rang theg pa chen por bslangs// khams gsum 'gro ba'i sgrib gnyis bcom// tshur 'dus sgo gsum sgrib dag nas// ye shes rang gsal ngang gnas gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ.oṃ ma ṇi padma'i hūm̐// zhes yig bcu kho na gtso bor bzla// thun mthar spro na de'i sham du// oṃ dhu ma gha ye na maḥswā hā/ ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes btags pa'ang ci rigs bzla'o// rdzogs pa'i rim pa sems nyid 'od gsal gyi 'khor lo la brten pa ni/ lus lha so so'i gnas su thim// rang yang 'od zhu thugs srog hrīḥr// de yang mas rim 'od du yal// nā da stong nyid 'od gsal dang*// spros pa'i mtha' bral lta ba rtogs// ma bcos rang lugs sgom par gnas// de las mi 'da' mnyam nyid spyod// brtan thob 'bras bu sku bzhi'i bdag /thugs rje chen po'i mchog thob nas// khams gsum 'khor ba dong sprugs shog /ces dge ba bsngo zhing khyer so gsum gyi grub mtha' lam du bslang bar bya'o// sgrib pa myur du sbyong ba'i phul// mchog thun gcig car sgrub pa'i thabs// 'dis kyang mu mtha' med pa'i 'gro// srid pa'i mtsho las rab sgrol shog /ba mkhal ma'i gzhung gi dngos bstan la rigs 'gres ma bslad pa'i rgyun khyer 'di'ang karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtshos dpal spungs yang khrod du sbyar ba dge legs 'phel// ༈ /thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho lugs gnyis gang la sbyar yang rung ba'i gnas lung khyer bder bsdus pa thugs rje'i 'phrul zhags zhes bya ba bzhugs so// mi bzad ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal ni// mtshan tsam gyis kyang skyob mdzad pa// thugs rje'i dbang phyug la btud nas// gnas lung cho ga 'dus gsal spel// byang chub kyi sems rin po che rnam pa gnyis la rtag tu gnas shing rim pa gnyis kyi ting nge 'dzin dang ldan pa'i sgrub pa po gang zhig

las dang bag chags kyi gzhan dbang du gyur pas 'khor ba'i 'khor lor yang srid lu gu rgyud du nying mtshams sbyor ba'i 'gro ba la phan gdags par 'dod pas gnas lung gi cho ga brtsam par skabs su babs pa ni/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho lha dgu lha lnga gang dang 'brel ba de'i dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod kyi chas/ tshogs kyi yo byad dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ lho sgor sbyong stegs 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad bris pa'i gdan la tshe 'das kyi ming byang dri rten gos bzang gis klubs pa/ bgegs gtor/ gul yungs/ til nag khrus chas/ zas bsngo sogs nye bar mkho ba rnams tshogs par byas la/ bdag mdun bum sgrub bdag 'jug tshogs mchod kyi bar du dkyus ltar btang*/ tshogs la ma rol pa'i bar der 'dir 'jug lha lnga'i skabs bdag mdun bzlas pa yan grub nas dkyil chog chen mo gtang skabs bum sgrub lha dgus rigs 'gre bskyed chog 'dor len phyed par bya zhing*/ bsdus pa tshigs bcad ma'i skabs su/ bsang sbyang*/ pad zla'i steng du bam̐ dkar las// mtshan nyid yongs rdzogs bum pa'i dbus// padma nyi steng hrīḥdamar las// bcom ldan rgyal ba rgya mtsho gsal// steng dang g.yas g.yon 'og gi char// pad 'byung grub thob rgya mtsho dang*// rta mgrin dpa' bo rgya mtsho dang*// gsang ye dpa' mo rgya mtsho dang*// mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho rnams// sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan cha lugs// gsal la ma 'dres yongs su rdzogs// las bum nang du rta mgrin rgyal// dmar po phyag g.yas rdo rje dang*// g.yon pas sdigs mdzub zhags pa bsnams// khro bo'i chas ldan me dpung klong*// brkyang bskum pad nyi'i gdan la 'gying*// kun gyi gnas gsum 'bru gsum dang*// thugs srog 'od kyis ye shes pa// spyan drangs gnyis su med par gyur// badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ slar yang dbang lha spyan drangs te// dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag

/chu lhag yar lud gtso 'khor kun// 'od dpag med pas rgyas btab gyur// mchod rdzas rnams la bdud rtsi gtor zhing bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las ka pā la// yangs pa'i nang du hūm̐ yig las// mchod rdzas dwangs shing thogs med pa// kun bzang mchod sprin lta bur gyur// oṃ badzra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du/ dhū pe dang puṣpe nas shabda'i bar du sbyar bas byin brlab/ oṃ/ mchod yon bdug spos me tog snang gsal dri// zhal zas rol mo sha lnga rigs kyi yum// zag med bde chen bdud rtsi bde ba'i gnas// sha chen gsur dud zhun me dga' bde rgyas// snang ba sna tshogs lhan skyes ye shes bde// rang byung kun mkhyen ye shes mchod pa'i sprin// mchod par bzhes la dngos grub stsal du gsol// oṃ badzra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ de bzhin tu dhū pe dang puṣpe sogs sbyar bas mchod/ oṃ/ thugs rje chen po 'jig rten dbang phyug sku// sku mdog dmar gsal 'jig rten dbang du sdud// spyan gyi 'od zer 'gro la thugs rjes gzigs// zhal nas hūm̐ sgras stong gsum chos sgra sgrogs// shangs nas ye shes rlung gis nyon mongs 'thor// snyan gnyis thabs dang shes rab 'dul thabs mdzad// phyag gnyis dbyings dang ye shes gnyis med sbyor// g.yas pas bgrang phreng byang chub lam sna 'dren// g.yon pas padma 'khor ba'i skyon dang bral// zhabs gnyis 'gro ba'i don la mnyam par bzhugs// rin chen rgyan drug pha rol phyin drug ldan// 'gro rnams ma lus thugs rjes dbang du sdud// 'jig rten dbang phyug sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// bstod par 'os pa thams cad la// zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyi// lus btud pa yis rnams kun tu// mchog tu gus pas phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bstod/ rang srog sngags las 'od zer ser po 'phros// gzungs thag brgyud de bum lha'i rgyud bskul gyur// yig bcu sogs bzla/

las bum la/ oṃ hrīḥpadmānta krita badzra kro dha ha ya grī ba hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bzlas la/ bum lha bde chen bdud rtsi'i ngo bor gyur// khro bo'i rgyal pos las rnams bsgrub par mdzod// de nas dmigs rten mdun du bkod/ las bum gyi chus bran la bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las yi ge nṛ yongs su gyur pa las tshe las 'das pa gson po'i dus kyi gzugs dang cha lugs ji lta bas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la gdong phyogs te 'dud pas gnas par gyur/ rang dang dkyil 'khor pa'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ tshe 'das kyi rnam shes rlung med pa'i mar me lta bu bkug ste de'i spyi bo nas zhugs snying gar gnas par gyur/ hūm̐ mdzad kyi rgyas/ na mo/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten dbang phyug rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams kyi bka' bden pa'i mthus/ tshe las 'das pa'i rnam par shes pa rigs drug skye gnas bzhi gar gnas kyang skad cig gis 'dir mchis par gyur cig lan gsum gyis bkug dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs bstim/ bgegs gtor a kā ros brlab g.yas g.yon tu bskor la/ oṃ sarba bighnan na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyo bi shwa mu khe bhyaḥsarba thā khaṃ utga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛhṇe daṃ ba lya di swā hā/ lan gsum gyis bsngos la/ hūm̐/ sha dang mar dang khur ba dang*// dza gad gtor ma 'di sbyin gyis// lha klu gnod sbyin dri za dang*// lto 'phye sa bdag rigs rnams dang*// grul bum dang ni gnyan gyi rigs// yi dwags sha za'i rigs rnams dang*// de bzhin stobs chen bdud kyi rigs// btsan dang rgyal po 'khor bcas dang*// ma mo gshin rje la sogs pa// khyed rnams kun gyi lan chags ni// skad cig nyid la bral gyur te// tshe 'das rigs kyi bu 'di dang*// lus dang grib bzhin ma 'grogs shig

/ngan song gsum gyi lam ma ston// tshe las 'das pa'i sems can 'di'i// sems kyi mdud pa myur du khrol// gtor ma dor la bgegs bskrad pa ni/ hūm̐/ nga ni padma dbang chen te// thams cad nga yis rang dbang sgyur// nga yi bka' las ma 'gal bar// rang rang gnas su byer bar gyis// rta sngags dang sumbha drag tu brjod/ gu gul dang yungs kar gyis bskrad/ til dang me chu bshams la/ tshe las 'das pa'i snying gar thogs med nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib kaṃ nag po las sdig pa rwa can gyi rnam par gnas pa de/ lte ba nas ye shes kyi me'i 'od kyis ded pas mdun gyi til la thim par gyur/ mer sreg cing chur dor la/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na bhasmi ku ru swā hā/ lan gsum/ sngags btab pa'i bye yungs kyis brabs la yig bcu dang*/ sbyong rgyud nas gsungs pa'i sngags gang lcogs dang*/ kaṃ ka ni dang yig brgya bzla/ de nas rten la khrus gsol ba ni/ khrus kyi khang pa shin tu dri zhim pa// shel gyi sa gzhi gsal zhing 'tsher ba bstar// rin chen 'bar ba'i ka ba yid 'ong ldan// mu tig 'od chags bla res bres pa der// ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs la nyon mongs mi mnga' yang*// dmigs yul lus ngag yid gsum sgrib pa sbyang slad du// rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs la khrus chab 'di gsol bas// dmigs yul lus ngag yid gsum sgrib pa dag gyur cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs khrus gsol/ de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos// gtsang la dri rab bgos pas sku phyi'o// oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥsarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bi sho dha ne swā hā/ zhes sku phyi/ de nas de la kha dog legs bsgyur ba'i// na bza' shin tu dri zhim dam pa 'bul// gos bzang srab la 'jam pa sna tshogs dang*// rgyan mchog brgya phrag de dang de dag gis// 'phags pa kun tu bzang dang 'jam dbyangs dang*// 'jig rten dbang phyug sogs la brgyan par bgyi// sna tshogs dbang po'i gzhu ltar rab bkra zhing*// gang la reg na bde ba'i rgyur gyur pa'i// gos bzang rin chen bdag blo sbyong phyir 'bul// bzod pa dam pa'i gos kyis brgyan par shog

/oṃ badzra wast+ra āḥhūm̐/ zhes rgyan dang na bza' phul/ khrus chu las bum du blugs pas dmigs rten bkru zhing*/ tshe las 'das pa rigs kyi bu// nyon drug rgyu las log pa'i gnas// 'di nas steng 'og 'jig rten na// 'gro drug ces bya 'jigs rung ba'i// sdug bsngal rnam pa sna tshogs pa// mi bzad khyod kyis myong 'gyur te// de las bsgral bar bya ba'i phyir// phyin drug chu bo 'dis bkru'o// yi ge bcu pa dang*/ tshe las 'das pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad shudhe shuddhe bi shuddhe swā hā/ zhes pa tsam mam/ cung zad spro na/ gzugs kyi phung po rnam dag pas// nyon mongs gti mug sbyong byed pa// me long lta bu'i ye shes kyis// dpal ldan sku yi khrus gsol lo// sngags brjod pa 'gre/ rnam shes phung po rnam dag pas// nyon mongs zhe sdang sbyong byed pa// chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyis// dpal ldan thugs kyi khrus gsol lo// tshor ba'i phung po rnam dag pas// nyon mongs nga rgyal sbyong byed pa// mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes kyis// dpal ldan yon tan khrus gsol lo// 'du shes phung po rnam dag pas// nyon mongs 'dod chags sbyong byed pa// so sor rtog pa'i ye shes kyis// dpal ldan gsung gi khrus gsol lo// 'du byed phung po rnam dag pas// nyon mongs phrag dog sbyong byed pa// bya ba grub pa'i ye shes kyis// dpal ldan phrin las khrus gsol lo// bum chus rten la byab cing*/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum// 'di dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste// dkon mchog gsum po dug mi mnga'// dkon mchog bden pas dug bcom mo// zhes dang*/ 'byung bzhi dug gi pha yin te// 'byung bzhi dug gi ma yang yin// bden pa'i bden tshig 'di dag gis// dug gsum 'byung bzhi'i nang du song*// tshe las 'das pa'i nyon mongs pa dug gsum dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pas 'byung ba'i bag la zha bar gyur cig

'byung ba'i ngang du thim par gyur cig me tog 'thor zhing*/ sangs rgyas bsod nams mthu dag dang*// lha rnams kun gyi bsam pa yis// khyod kyi 'dod don gang yin pa// don de de ring 'grub gyur cig /rkang gnyis khyed cag bde legs shog /rkang bzhi khyed cag bde legs shog /khyod cag lam 'gro bde legs shog /phyir 'ong dag kyang bde legs shog /nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs// nyi ma'i gung yang bde legs shing*// nyin mtshan kun tu bde legs shog /khyod cag sdig par ma gyur cig /tshe las 'das pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rgyal bar gyur cig de nas/ gtso bo rgyal ba 'gro ba'i mgon// 'gro ba skyob pa'i don brtson pa// stobs chen 'jigs pa kun sel bar// de ring nyid nas skyabs su mchi// de yi thugs su chud pa'i chos// 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa sel ba dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs la yang*// de bzhin yang dag skyabs su mchi// dmigs yul 'jigs pas rnam skrag ste// kun tu bzang la dmigs yul 'bul// 'jam pa'i dbyangs la bdag nyid kyis// dmigs yul lus 'di 'bul bar bgyi// thugs rje'i spyod pa ma 'khrul ba'i// spyan ras gzigs mgon de la yang*// nyam thag nga ros 'o dod 'bod// sdig ldan 'di la bskyab tu gsol// 'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po dang*// sa yi snying po dag dang ni// thugs rje che mgon thams cad la// skyabs gsol snying nas 'o dod 'bod// gang zhig mthong na gshin rje yi// pho nya la sogs 'jigs pa rnams// skrag nas phyogs bcur 'byer byed pa// rdo rje can la skyabs su mchi// sngon chad khyed kyi bka' las 'das// da ni 'jigs pa che mthong nas// khyod la skyabs su mchi lags kyi// 'jigs las myur du bskyab tu gsol// zhes phyag bya/ de nas dbang bskur ba ni lha dgu yin na dbang bskur yongs rdzogs sam/ dbang bzhi pa yan chad dam/

rig pa'i dbang lnga yan chad tshang bar bskur/ lha lnga la'ang de ltar byas kyang rung mod/ 'dir bsdus pa la dga' bas/ khrus/ maṇḍal/ padma dbang gi dkyil 'khor du// mgon po gzi brjid 'od dpag med// rgyal sras tshogs dang bcas pa la// dbang skur yongs su rdzogs pa ltar// de bzhin bla ma khyed kyis kyang*// bdag la dbang bskur mdzad du gsol// lan gsum/ spro na/ phyogs bcu dus gsum sogs nas/ zab cing rgya che bstan tu gsol// bar gzhung ltar la/ bsdu na/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa mi dge so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// rang gzhan don ni rab sgrub phyir// byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi// byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas// sems can thams cad bdag gis mgron du gnyer// byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces brjod/ khyed rang rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i skur gsal ba'i// lte bar pad steng g.yung drung g.yon tu 'khyil// hrīḥl sngags kyis bskor ba'i 'od zer gyis// sangs rgyas byang sems dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams// char ltar bab byon lus ngag yid la thim// lus sems bde ba chen pos khyab par gyur// sngags sham du/ ā be sha ya ā be sha ya aḥ.āḥ zhes btags pa bzla/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la/ tiṣṭha badzra/ mdun gyi nam mkhar ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor gsal ba dang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs rin po che'i bum pa thogs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur bar gyur/ bum pas dbang bskur la/ spyan ras gzigs dbang 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon// sangs rgyas rnams kyi bum pa'i dbang*// deng 'dir khyod la bskur bar bya// chos dbyings ye shes dbang 'di khyod kyis longs// yig bcu'i sham du/

oṃ buddha a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ye shri hūm̐/ de ltar dbang bskur bas nyon mongs pa lnga dag phung po lnga gnas gyur/ 'od dpag med gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs lngas dbu brgyan par gyur/ thod pa'i bdud rtsi sbyin la/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi thod pa'i dbang*// sangs rgyas rnams kyis rab bsgrubs pa// de ring khyod la bskur bar bgyi// gsang mchog thod pa'i dbang 'di yongs rdzogs shog /oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ.oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ oṃ dhu ma gha ye na maḥswā hā/ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ sindhū ra'i me long gtad la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi shes rab dbang*// sangs rgyas kun gyis rab bsgrubs pa// de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// shes rab ye shes dbang 'di yongs rdzogs shog /oṃ dhū ma gha ye na maḥswā hā/ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ/ rdo rje bstan la/ ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing*// rdo rje nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu// rdul bral thar sbyin zhi ba nyid// khyod kyi pha ni khyod nyid do// zhes ngo sprad/ bum pa'i dbang ni dang po ste// gsang ba'i dbang ni gnyis pa'o// shes rab ye shes gsum pa ste// nges shes bskyed pa bzhi pa'o// lha dang sngags dang stong pa nyid// bde stong 'dres par bsgom pa dbang*// tha mal lus kyi rnam rtog ni// dang po bum pa'i dbang gis bcad// rang bzhin lha yi rnam par bsgom// tha mal ngag gi rnam rtog ni// gnyis pa gsang ba'i dbang gis bcad// bzlas brjod rgyun tu bzlas pa'o// tha mal sems kyi rnam rtog ni// gsum pa shes rab dbang gis bcad// bde dang stong pa'i don dran bya// 'bras bu thams cad bsdus pa ni// bzhi pa ye shes dbang yin no// gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa// de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi// maṇḍal/

deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du// khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags na// khyed kyis slob mar bzung ba dang*// cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol// de ltar dbang bskur bas tshe 'das kyi sgo gsum lha'i ngo bor gyur/ 'dod yon rnams bsang sbyang*/ a kā ros brlab/ oṃ/ zas longs tshe 'das rigs kyi bu// nga ni dbang chen dpal gyi sku// sangs rgyas kun dang rab sbyor ba'i// ye shes 'od zer kun tu 'phro// thams cad 'dod pa tshims byed pa// bcud chen ro mchog stong dang ldan// 'di ni sngon gyi dam tshig ste// de phyir khyod kyis zas 'di longs// sngon tshe rgyal po tshe 'das rnams// zas gtad tshims shing grol ba ltar// tshe 'das khyod la zas gtad kyi// zas 'di longs la rang sems ltos// tshe 'das rigs kyi bu khyod kyang*// phyis nas rgyu 'di ma len par// skye med byang chub dran par gyis// rang snang chos nyid dbang thob shog /bde ba can gyi zhing khams nas// chos nyid 'od gsal lhun re stug /zas 'di longs la dbyings su gshegs// 'khor ba 'di la ma chags shig /de nas dmigs rten lag tu thogs te/ rgyas par na/ chos sku dri med rdo rje 'chang*// spyan ras gzigs dbang 'gro ba'i mgon// tshe 'das sems nyid mchod par 'bul// gti mug dbyings su sgrol mdzad gsol// byang sems rnam par dag pa yi// rnam snang rgyal po gangs chen mtsho// tshe 'das phung po mchod par 'bul// ma dag gzugs kyi phung po sgrol// mi 'gyur rdo rje lta bu yi// mi bskyod rdo rje rigs kyi gtso// tshe 'das rnam shes mchod par 'bul// zhe sdang dbyings su sgrol mdzad gsol// dri med padma lta bu yi// 'chi med rgyal po 'od dpag med// tshe 'das 'du shes mchod par 'bul// 'dod chags dbyings su sgrol mdzad gsol// yid bzhin nor bu lta bu yi// yon tan thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas// tshe 'das tshe rab mchod par 'bul// nga rgyal dbyings su sgrol mdzad gsol// phrin las thams cad yongs rdzogs shing*// rgyal ba'i dgongs pa rdzogs mdzad pa// tshe 'das 'du byed mchod par 'bul// phrag dog dbyings su sgrol mdzad gsol//

༈ /dus gsum sangs rgyas sku gsung thugs// rgyal ba rgya mtsho spyan ras gzigs// tshe 'das skye mched mchod par 'bul// khams gsum skye med dbyings su sgrol// rang bzhin gdod nas dag pa la// tshogs gnyis zung 'jug phrin las kyis// bar dor gnas pa'i 'gro ba rnams// thugs rje'i lcags kyus myur du drongs// zhes sam/ bsdu na/ dus gsum sangs rgyas sku gsung thugs man brjod/ de nas/ tshe 'das rgyud kyi ma dag pa'i// phung po khams dang skye mched rnams// sku lnga ye shes lnga yi mes// bsregs pas byang zhing dag par gyur// sngags rnams brjod cing ming byang bsregs la thal ba sātstsha gdab pa'am gtsang sar dor/ lam bstan pa ni/ 'di nas phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na// dri ma med pa'i 'od la sogs// rnam dag sangs rgyas zhing rnams ni// padmo'i dpal sogs bde gshegs rnams// 'tsho gzhes khyod la nyer dgongs te// tshe 'das skal ldan rigs kyi bu// rgyal ba de dag zhing du gshegs// oṃ ratne ratne ma hā ratne ratne saṃ bha we/ ratna kī ra ṇe/ ratna mā lā bi shuddhe sho dha ya sarba pā paṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ padmo 'dam gyis ma gos ltar// srid gsum dri mas ma gos kyang*// srid pa'i padmo las byung ba// bde ba can du skye bar shog /oṃ padme padme padma saṃ bha ba ma hā su kha wa ti gatstshantu swā hā/ rigs kyi bu de 'od dpag med sogs phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sras su gyur te de la rgyal sras thams cad kyis mchod cing bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyis chos kyi rgyal srid chen por dbang bskur bar gyur to// shis brjod dang bsngo smon bya/ de nas tshogs la rol zhing lhag ma dang rjes kyi cho ga rnams ni gzhung las 'byung ba ltar bya'o// rang byung nam mkhar spyod pa'i gzhung bzang las// dkon mchog 'bangs kyis bsdus shing gsal bar mdzad// de las rang 'dra'i sher brtson dman rnams phyir// bsdus te bklags chog nyid du bkod pa'i dges// 'jigs rung srid pa'i 'khrul 'khor la// las kyis bcings pa'i 'gro ba kun// padmas brgyan pa'i zhing mchog tu// 'jig rten mgon pos dgrol bar shog

/ces pa'ang thugs rje che dngos kun mkhyen bla ma mtsho skyes dgyes pa'i bka' lung rjes su bsgrub slad/ zab chos 'di nyid kyi snod ldan tu gyur pa karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtshos dpal spungs yang khrod kun bzang bde chen 'od gsal gling du bris pa dge legs 'phel// ༈ /rtsa gsum spyi la sbyar du rung ba'i sreg blugs kyi cho ga mdor bsdus pa kun la phan pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na maḥshrī māṃ gu ra be/ ji ltar nor bu'i rgyal po ni// sna tshogs tshon gyi mdangs 'dzin ltar// mos pa dang mtshungs mchog dngos kyi// 'dod pa 'jo ba de la 'dud// rnal 'byor rgyun gyi bya ba'am// gang dag bsnyen pa'i kha skong dang*// spros med spyod dang 'tshams pa yi// sreg blugs bya ba mdor bsdus bshad// las nye bar bsdus pa'i cho ga 'di la don gsum/ spyir sbyin sreg bsdus pa'i lag len/ bye brag bsnyen pa kha skong bya tshul/ spros med rdzas gcig kho na la brten pa rnams so// dang po ni/ zhi rgyas dbang drag gang byed kyi me thab spyi mthun bris la/ las dang mthun pa'i bud shing zlum po gru bzhi zla gam gru gsum ste so so'i dbyibs su brtsig bris thab tsam yang ma grub na sa stegs la lha grangs dang mthun pa'i tshom bu las mdog bkod kyang rung bar gsungs/ zhi rgyas dbang gsum la rang gi g.yon phyogs su phyi mchod phreng tshar/ las mthun gyi 'bul gtor che chung gnyis/ g.yas su bsreg rdzas kyi gtso bo mar khu dang yam shing*/ de'ang zhi ba la ba lu sogs 'o ma can gyi shing mthe'u chung gi tshad sor bcu gnyis pa sbrang 'o ma mar khus sbags pa dang*/ til/ yungs kar/ gro/ rgyas pa la shug pa dang 'o se sogs 'bras bu can gyi shing sbom po khru gang pa dri bzang mar gyis bgos pa dang*/ dūrba/ zho/ 'bras/ nas/ sran ma/ so ba/ shing tog dbang la 'om bu dang mdzo mo shing sogs me tog 'bras bu dmar zhing ro skyur ba'i shing srin mdzub gyi tshad sor brgyad pa bdud rtsi lnga dang mngar gsum gyis byugs pa dang*/

zas mchog me tog dmar po/ drag po la skyer tsher sor bcu gnyis pa dug khrag tu bsnyugs pa dang*/ tsha ba gsum bsres pa'i bag phye'i ling chung dang sha khrag bcas 'du bya/ mar khu dang yam shing ni med du mi rung la/ gzhan sdig pa zhi ba la til/ bgegs zhi ba la yungs kar/ tshe rgyas pa la dūrbas mtshon skabs kyi dgos pa dang bstun gang 'dzom gyis chog cing*/ de dag kyang so sor mi 'dod na/ zhi sogs gsum la phye mar la so so'i rdzas gang 'dzom dang sman sna rin po che dar zab shing tog sogs bsres pa'i rdzas spungs kho na bsham/ nang mchod/ ku sha'i chun po lnga/ bsang chu/ dgang blugs/ me yol sogs spyi ltar 'du bya/ bdag bskyed lha'i rnal 'byor bzlas pa bsdu ldangs bcas grub pa dang*/ bsang sbyang*/ bsang chu'i steng du hūm̐ yig las// bgegs rnams mthar byed bdud rtsi 'khyil// ljang gu rgya gram sdigs mdzub can// khro chas rab 'bar skur gsal ba'i// thugs kar nyi steng hūm̐ yig la// sngags phreng g.yas su bskor bar gyur// oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ci 'grub bzla/ khro bo 'od zhu chu yi rngul// bgegs rnams bskrad pa'i nus ldan gyur// dkyil 'khor so so'i las bum sgrub pa dang 'brel na 'di mi dgos la/ spyi tsam du 'di yis chog go /rdo rje bzung la/ oṃ ma hā badzra hūm̐/ dril bu bzung la/ oṃ badzra gaṇḍe aḥ dpal 'bar la bsang chu 'thor/ las sngags brjod/ oṃ badzra dzwa la dzwa la hūm̐/ zhes thab kyi shar lho nas spar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis rlung g.yab/ dkyil 'khor so so'i las sngags sam spyi tsam du badzra a mṛ ta brjod la mar khu dgang blugs gsum gsum 'bul/ oṃ/ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge /tshangs pa lha rnams dag byed yin// dkon mchog gsum po mnyes byed pa// sa las skyes pa'i 'dab ma'i steng*// bdag gi bgegs rnams thams cad ni// zhi dang bkra shis mdzad du gsol// swā hā/

oṃ badzra sa twa āḥ zhes sngags lan lnga brjod la ku sha'i chun po gcig thab kyi steng du bzhag pa me lha'i gdan tu bsam/ bzhi po rang gi g.yon nas brtsams te thab kyi phyogs bzhir rtse mo mdun du blta ba sngon 'gros bkram/ mchod rdzas rnams rang gzhung mchod pa byin rlabs dang*/ bsreg rdzas rnams so so'i bdud rtsi byin rlabs ltar brlabs pa'i rjes su/ ngo bo bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin la// rnam pa bsreg rdzas so sor gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ṭhaḥṭhaḥṭhaḥṭhaḥṭhaḥṭhaḥṭhaḥ dgang blugs kha sbyar bas reg ste/ mar khu la/ oṃ āḥswā hā/ yam shing la/ oṃ shrīṃ swā hā/ 'bru la/ oṃ dzriṃ swā hā/ rdzas spyir/ oṃ swā hā/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ thab bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las las mthun gyi// thab khung mtshan nyid yongs rdzogs dbus// zhi ba'i me lha dkar po ni// zhes sam/ rgyas pa'i me lha ser po/ dbang gi me lha dmar po/ drag po'i me lha nag po zhes so sor bsgyur/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis me thab dang*// ril ba 'dzin pa drang srong tshul// ra skyes la gnas gnas gsum du// 'bru gsum 'od kyis spyan drangs gyur// oṃ/ tshur byon tshur byon 'byung po che// lha yi rgyal po bram ze mchog /sreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du// 'dir ni yang dag bsnyen par mdzod// oṃ ṭakki hūm̐ dzaḥ thab kyi shar lhor me tog gcig 'phangs la/ thab kyi shar lhor ku sha'i gdan la bzhugs par gyur/ oṃ agna ye sa pa ri bā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ de bzhin pā dyaṃ sbyar bas chu gnyis kyis mchod/ lag g.yas rtse gsum rgya bcas/ oṃ badzra ā na la ma hā bhū ta dzwa lā ya sarba bhasmin ku ru sarba duṣṭaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ dṛ shya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya st+waṃ/ sa ma ya haṃ/ zhes dam la bzhag dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig ye shes dbyer med gyur// slar yang dbang lhas dbang bskur te// rigs kyi bdag pos dbur brgyan gyur// oṃ agna ye sa pā ri bā ra puṣpe pra tītstsha swā hā/

shabda'i bar du 'gre/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras// me lha'i rgyal po ṭakkis dbang bskur ba// shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad sreg /'dzin byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud// byon zan 'bul ba/ dgang blugs kha la hūm̐ yig gsal// me lha cung zad zhal gdangs pa'i// ljags la ram̐ yig gis mtshan pas// bsreg rdzas bdud rtsi bzhes par gyur// na maḥs manta buddha nāṃ oṃ agna ye ha bya kā bya batna ya ā di bya/ zhes gsum mam bdun gyi mthar/ spel tshig ni/ zhi ba la/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// dam pa'i chos ldan bsam sbyor la// bar du gcod par byed rnams dang*// sdig sgrib nyes ltung nad gdon kun// sarba shīntaṃ ku ru swā hā/ rgyas pa la/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// dam pa'i chos ldan bsam sbyor dang*// tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor dang*// nor dang longs spyod snyan grags sogs// sarba puṣṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ dbang la/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// dam pa'i chos ldan 'tsho rkyen dang*// srid gsum skye dgu 'jig rten gyi// tshe dpal 'byor pa srog bcud rnams// sarba ba shaṃ ku ru hoḥ drag po la/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// dam pa'i chos ldan bsam sbyor la// bar du gcod par byed rnams dang*// dgra bgegs gnod byed ma lus pa// sarba mā ra ya phaṭa/ de nas bsreg rdzas yam shing*/ oṃ agna ye sa pa ri bā re bhyaḥ zhes lan gcig oṃ bo dhī bṛkṣa ya swā hā/ zhes pas bdun sogs phul mthar/ oṃ bo dhi bṛkṣa ya bdag cag dpon slob sogs 'dod gsol sbyar ba rigs 'gre/ mar khu lha sngags de mthar/ oṃ agna ye swā hā/ zhes pa spel tshig bcas las bzhi kar gsog zhi ba'i skabs/ ched du sdig pa zhi 'dod na til nag oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badzra ye swā hā/ bgegs zhi bar 'dod na yungs kar/ oṃ sarba artha siddha ye swā hā/

nad zhi bar 'dod na gro/ oṃ badzra ghasma ryai swā hā/ rgyas pa la/ tshe rgyas par 'dod na dūrba/ oṃ badzra ā yu ṣe swā hā/ shes rab la zho/ oṃ sarba samba de swā hā/ dpal 'byor la 'bras/ oṃ badzra puṣṭā ya swā hā/ lus kyi shugs la nas/ oṃ ma hā be gā ya swā hā/ stobs la sran ma/ oṃ ma hā ba lā ya swā hā/ nor 'bru la so ba/ oṃ badzra bī dzā ya swā hā/ rigs brgyud la shing tog oṃ badzra ṣī bā ya swā hā/ dbang la/ bde skyid dngos grub sdud na zas mchog oṃ sarba samba de swā hā/ spyi la lha sngags sham du 'bru gsum sbyar bas me tog dmar po sogs phul/ drag po la liṅga sha khrag bcas lha sngags 'bru gsum sbyar bas te/ de ltar rdzas so sor lhag par phul/ ched du mi spro ba'am rdzas ma 'dzom na mar khu yam shing gnyis po kho nas chog go /mthar/ gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar ba yi// lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod rdzas 'di// drang srong me lha'i tshogs la 'bul// bzhes nas zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod// oṃ agna ye sa pa ri bā ra puṣpe pra tītstsha swā hā/ sngags thog mtha' des 'gre ba'i/ shabda'i bar dang*/ pañtsa a mṛ ta/ ma taṃ gi

'di bsang mchod yin pas 'khyud rgya mdzad srol yod/ rnams kyis mchod/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras// me lha'i rgyal po ṭakkis dbang bskur ba// shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad sreg /'dzin byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud// ces bstod/ oṃ agna ye swā hā/ zhes dgang blugs lan gsum phul/ las sngags dang bsang chu 'thor/ me lha 'od zhu 'bar ba yi// rnam par gyur pa de yi dbus// zhes mtshams sbyar nas lha so so'i mdun bskyed dbang bskur rgyas gdab bar yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bsgom/ de'ang rgyal rgyam lha lnga'i sgrub thabs tshigs bcad ma dkon mchog 'bangs kyis mdzad pa la mtshon na/ 'od zer las grub gzhal yas khang*// zhes pa nas/ rigs lngas dbu la brgyan par gyur// ces pa'i bar mdun bskyed kyi dkyus ltar sbyar ba'i mthar/ zhi ba la/ lha tshogs thams cad zhi zhing 'dzum pa 'od zer dkar po'i phreng ba mkha' khyab tu 'phro bar gyur/ rgyas par/ lha tshogs thams cad brjid cing lhun chags pa 'od zer ser po'i phreng ba mkha' khyab tu 'phro bar gyur/ dbang la/ lha tshogs thams cad sgeg cing chags pa 'od zer dmar po'i phreng ba mkha' khyab tu 'phro bar gyur/ drag por/ lha tshogs thams cad khro gtum 'jigs rung 'od zer mthing ga'i phreng ba mkha' khyab tu 'phro bar gyur/ zhes bsgyur de nas byon skyems ni/ dgang blugs kha la hūm̐ yig gsal// bcom ldan 'das kyi ljags la yang*// hūm̐ yig dag gis mtshan pa yis// bsreg rdzas bdud rtsi bzhes par gyur// dkyil 'khor gang yin gyi gtso bo'i snying pos dgang blugs lan gsum phul/ spel tshig me lha ltar brjod/ de nas so so'i gzhung ltar mchod bstod tshang ba rgyas bsdus gang 'grub bya/ de'ang rgyal rgyam lha lnga'i sgrub thabs tshigs bcad mar mtshon na/ oṃ/ mchod yon bdug spos sogs kyis mchod/ bstod pa dkyus ltar ram bsdu na/

oṃ/ thugs rje chen po 'jig rten dbang phyug sku sogs nas/ 'jig rten dbang phyug sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces pa'i bar dang*/ bstod par 'os pa sogs kyis bstod/ de nas bsreg rdzas rnams lha sngags tshar re'i rjes rdzas sngags nyer gcig la sogs pa ci 'grub mthar spel tshig sbyar ba me lha'i skabs ltar 'bul/ yang na mar khu yam shing ma gtogs pa'i rdzas gzhan gang 'byor phyogs gcig bsres pa'i rdzas spungs nyid lha sngags mthar/ sa pa ri bā ra oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes sbyar ba kho nas 'bul ba la grangs 'dzin pa'ang phyag srol bar ma chad pa yin no// de nas zhi ba'i skabs/ bsreg rdzas phul bas lha tshogs rab tu mnyes/ lha rnams sku las 'od zer mu tig mdog /bde ba'i reg bya ldan pa dpag med 'phros// 'gro ba kun dang bdag dang bsrung bya yi// tshangs bug nas zhugs lus gang nad gdon sdig /ba mor nyi zer phog ltar dag gyur te// bde stong nyams skyes dri med shel ltar gyur// rgyas pa la/ bsreg rdzas phul bas lha tshogs rab tu mnyes// lha rnams sku las 'od zer gser gyi mdog /bdag dang bsrung bya la phog tshe bsod 'phel// 'od zer gseb nas rin chen char 'bebs gyur// dbang la/ bsreg rdzas phul bas lha tshogs rab tu mnyes// lha rnams 'od zer padma rā ga'i mdog /lcags kyu'i dbyibs 'phros 'jig rten spyi dang ni// bye brag dmigs bya gang yin mdun du bkug /gus 'dud ldan pa chags pa'i me yis zhu// 'od dmar gyur nas bdag la thim par bsam// drag po la/ lha rnams zhal khyim gnam sa tsam du gdangs// de nang sha khrag liṅga phul ba de// dgra bgegs dngos nyid rkang rting skya lhag lhag /mgo mjug ldog ste drag tu gsol bar bsgom// de ltar bsreg rdzas rdzogs mthar las bzhi kar dkyil 'khor rang gzhung ltar mchod cing bstod/ gtor ma bdud rtsi ltar byin brlab// snying po'i mthar/

sa pa ri bā ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum gyis 'bul/ bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas rnams kyis// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang*// longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*// zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs// dngos grub kun gyi stong grogs mdzod// dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*// gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod// 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*// 'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel ba// bde legs phun sum tshogs pa yi// yid la 'dod pa kun grub mdzod// 'dod don gsol ba ni/ snying po'i sngags kyis dgang blugs lan gsum phul la/ bdag cag dpon slob sogs gong ltar brjod/ yig brgya bzla zhing*/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*// gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni// bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba// de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod// ces pas nongs pa bzod par gsol/ oṃ/ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*// slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol// badzra muṃḥs ye shes pa gshegs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dam tshig pa rang la thim par gyur/ mar khu blugs gzar gang phul la/ oṃ agna ye swā hā/ slar yang me lha 'bar ba'i rnam pa las/ bzhengs te gzi brjid phun sum tshogs par gyur/ yam shing mar khu sogs bsreg rdzas rnams lan gsum sogs 'bul/ spel tshig mi sbyar/ oṃ agna ye sa pa ri wā ra puṣpe pra tītstsha swā hā/ de bzhin du shabda'i bar sbyar bas mchod/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras// me lha'i rgyal po ṭakkis dbang bskur ba// shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad sreg

/'dzin byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud// ces bstod/ gtor ma a kā ros byin brlab/ oṃ agna ye sa pa ri bā ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum gyis 'bul/ me ste bsreg bya za ba'i lha// drang srong rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /shar lho gdon gyi tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// nad med tshe dang sogs gong ltar brjod/ thal mo sbyar te/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// dam pa'i chos ldan bsam sbyor la zhes sogs las bzhi gang yin gyi 'dod don dmigs su gsol/ yig brgya/ bzod gsol gyi rjes su/ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don// byin za khyod kyis bsgrubs kyi gshegs// ji bzhin dus su slar byon te// bdag gi dngos grub thams cad sgrubs// oṃ agna ye sa pa ri bā ra badzra muḥ ye shes me lha shar lhor gshegs// dam tshig pa rnams snying gar thim// zhes dang bsngo smon bkra shis brjod la/ rjes me thal gyi bya ba spyi ltar bya'o// gnyis pa bsnyen pa kha skong gi sbyin sreg la/ dkyil 'khor gyi bsnyen pa yongs su rdzogs nas sngags dang 'brel pa'i sbyin sreg khri phrag gcig gis lha tshim par bya dgos pa rgyud sde mang po las gsungs shing*/ de'ang legs grub kyi rgyud las nyin par bzlas pa du song gi bcu cha'i sbyin sreg mtshan mor bya ba dang*/ yang na sngags bcu bcu bzlas shing sbyin sreg re re byas pas sngags 'bum dang sbyin sreg khri dus mnyam du 'gro ba dang*/ sambu ṭi las/ dang por sngags 'bum bzlas nas ni// phyis nas las ni yang dag brtsam// zhes gsungs pa'i lugs gsum las da lta phyi ma nyid lag len tu mdzad pas de'i tshul la'ang grub mtha' phal mo ches bsnyen pa'i kha skong yin phyin chad sngags kyi lhag chad skong ba la gtso bor dgongs nas zhi ba'i sbyin sreg kho na mdzad par snang zhing*/

de la'ang rgyas bsdus gnyis las rgyas par spro na zhi ba'i sreg blugs gong smos sam/ de las rgyas pa'ang grub na legs pa'i cha las skyon med cing*/ mdor bsdus pa'i phyag bzhes ni/ zhi thab/ bud shing*/ mchod rdzas/ bsreg rdzas mar khu yam shing til nag rdzas gzhan ma 'dzom na'ang chog cing dgang blugs sogs mkho ba'i yo byad sta gon tu byas la kha shar du phyogs pas bdag gi rnal 'byor bzlas pa bsdu ldangs bar byas la/ mchod bsreg rdzas byin brlab/ thab khung bhrūm̐ las gzhal yas khang gi nang du dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs bskyed la/ oṃ badzra uddiṣṭas rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam/ de nas me sbar zhing rlung g.yab mar khus gsos la de nas brtsams sbyin sreg grub kyi bar me ma shi bar bya/ de nang du/ oṃ badzra sa ma ya st+waṃ/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa thab kyi dbus su bzhugs par gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam/ mchod bstod sgrub thabs ltar grub nas/ lha so so'i sngags mthar rdzas sngags dang*/ bdag gi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes sam/ shin tu bsdu na 'bru gsum gyi mthar spel tshig sbyar ba'ang snang zhing gang ltar sngags 'bum phrag re la sbyin sreg khri re 'gro ba dang rdzas kyang til nag la gtso bor bya/ thun mthar dkyil 'khor pa la mchod bstod dngos grub blang*/ nongs pa bshags/ lha rnams rang la bsdu/ me thab sa gsar pas g.yogs la sba/ nangs par cho ga la sngar bzhin 'jug yang phyag len 'ga' zhig tu lha spyi khyab la zhi ba/ tshe nor gyi lha la rgyas pa/ dbang drag la'ang so so'i sreg blugs kyis kha skong ba'ang snang bas de lta na spel tshig kyang so sor bsgyur shes par bya'o// gsum pa shin tu spros med rdzas gcig kho na la brten pa ni/ thab kyi me'am/

mdun tu me khrol sogs me snod bzhag zhi ba la til yungs 'du byas pa la sna g.yas nas rlung bus la/ bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi// sdig sgrib nyes ltung bag chags kun// bsdus te til la thim par gyur// me dbus zhi ba'i thab khung yongs rdzogs nang*// yi dam gtso rkyang mdog dkar 'od zer 'bar// zhi zhing 'dzum pa'i nyams dang ldan pa yi// zhal du bsreg rdzas phul bas sgrib sbyangs gyur// zhes mos la yi dam gang yin gyi sngags sham du/ bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa sarba pā pam̐ da ha na shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes btags pa kho nas ci 'grub phul la/ arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ bstod pa shwa lo ka gcig gis bstod/ lha nyid 'od zhu rang la thim par mos/ rgyas pa la rin chen phye ma 'bru sna zas sna dar sna sogs gang 'dzom bran/ a kā ro lan gsum brjod pas/ bsreg rdzas rnams bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur/ me dkyil rgyas pa'i thab khung mtshan nyid rdzogs// de dbus yi dam gser mdog 'od zer 'bar// bsreg rdzas bdud rtsi'i dwangs ma phul bas mnyes// rin chen char 'bebs 'byor drug spel bar gyur// sngags sham du/ dzwa la raṃ raṃ ratna siddhi hūm̐/ zhes ci nus 'bul/ mchod bstod bsdu ba sngar dang 'dra/ dbang la me tog dmar po dngos sam 'bru la tshon gyis kha bsgyur ba/ sindhu ra/ chang gi glum/ shing tog dmar po la sogs pa phyogs gcig tu bran/ gong ltar byin brlab/ me dkyil dbang gi thab khung mtshan nyid rdzogs// de dbus yi dam gtso rkyang sku mdog dmar// 'od zer dmar pos snang srid dbang du sdud// bsreg rdzas myos byed bdud rtsi gsol bar gyur// rtsa sngags sham du/ sarba lo ka ba shaṃ ku ru hrīḥ zhes ci nus 'bul la mchod bstod sogs gong ltar ro// drag po la thod ting zangs lcags kyi snod du yungs kar blugs/ rang nyid yi dam thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis// dgra bgegs bkug nas rdzas la thim par gyur/

hūm̐/ dkon mchog gsum dang yi dam lha// mkha' 'gro chos skyong bden pa'i mthus// gnod byed dgra bgegs byad ma rnams// drag po'i bsreg rdzas 'di la khug /nri tri badzra aṅku sha dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes lan gsum brjod/ me nang drag po'i thab khung rab tu 'bar// de dbus drag po'i lha mchog 'jigs su rung*// zhal dang sku lus me yi rang bzhin can// gnam sa tsam gyi zhal chen gdangs pa'i nang*// yungs 'bru re re dgra bgegs dngos gyur pa// mgo mjug ldog ste rkang mthil skya lhag bzhes// lus ngag yid gsum dngos med bsregs shing bcom// sems nyid stong gsal chos skur thim par gyur// sngags sham/ gnod byed dgra bgegs byad ma mā ra ya phaṭa/ ces pa brgya rtsa sogs phul/ mchod bstod bsdu rim gong ltar bya/ de ltar spros med lugs 'di la tshe srog gi ngo bo gdod nas gos dkar mo'i ngo bor rnam par dag pa shes pas me lha mchod pa'i don tshang*/ 'khor rnams nyi ma dang 'od zer bzhin gtso bo'i ye shes kyi rang mdangs yin par shes pas zur du bskyed mi dgos/ bsreg rdzas rnams kyang sne re re'am gang 'byor tsam gyis chog pas ting nge 'dzin gtso bor byed pa'i rnal 'byor pa rnams la zab cing lag tu blang bde ba'i gdams pa'o// nyon mongs bsreg za dri med ye shes kyi// me dpung khams gsum yongs la mched nas kyang*// srid pa'i rgya mtsho gting nas skam pa dang*// sems dpa' rdo rje'i bde drod rab 'bar shog /ces pa 'di'ang 'khor lo'i dbang phyug thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen po'i bka' yis rjes su gnang ba ltar/ 'du gsum gyi rnal 'byor spyod pa karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtshos dpal spungs yang khrod tsā 'dra rin chen brag gi sgrub gnas kun bzang bde chen 'od gsal gling du sbyar ba dge legs 'phel// ༈ /rten gsum rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga kun mkhyen rang byung yab sras kyi bzhed pa'i snying po bsdus pa rnam dag dgongs gsal zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru shākya rā dza ya/

rab brtan ye shes rdo rje dam tshig gi /phyag rgya'i srog tu gzhug tshe bem pos kyang*// sangs rgyas phrin las lhun gyis grub mdzad pa// dngos kun khyab bdag gang des shis pa stsol// rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga mkhas rnams kyis// rgyas bsdus mang du mdzad mod rang mnyam gyis// lag tu len bde rgyud 'grel rtsa ba'i don// rang bzo med par 'chad la skyon yod min// rten gsum la sogs pa rnams gsang gsum phrin las dang bcas pa so so'i bdag nyid du lhag par rab tu gnas par sgrub pa la/ jo bo rjes/ don dam spros bral rab gnas dang*// kun rdzob sku gsung thugs kyi'o// zhes gsungs pa ltar gnyis las/ snga ma ni ye shes la dbang thob pa'i skyes bu chen po rnams kyis dgongs pa gtad pa tsam gyis/ ri brag sogs rang byung dang bcos pa'i rten gang yin kyang ye shes chen po'i 'khor lor byin gyis rlob nus pas cho ga la ma ltos shing*/ phyi ma ni/ rdo rje gur las/ rtag tu sangs rgyas rab gnas bya// zin pa'i de ma thag pa ru// rab tu gnas pa mchog tu 'gyur// ces gsungs pa'i don rgyud sde so so'i dgongs pa dang mthun pa'i cho ga tshad dang ldan pa rgyas 'bring bsdus pa gang rung gis bya dgos la/ de'ang gang la rab tu gnas pa'i rten chags tshad dang ldan pa/ gang gis rab gnas byed pa'i slob dpon mtshan nyid dang ldan pa/ ji ltar rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga'i tshul phyin ci ma log pa kho na gal che ste/ de dag tshad dang mi ldan pas ni 'phral yun kun tu nyes pa du ma skyed par byed la/ de las ldog pas thun mong dang mchog gi dngos grub bde blag tu 'jo ba rdo rje 'chang nyid kyis yang gdams par mdzad pa ltar rgya bod kyi gzhung tshad ma rnams las rgyas bsdus lag len ci rigs 'byung ba las/ sgrub brgyud kaṃ tshang gi phyogs su thams cad mkhyen pa rang byung zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i rab gnas bum gnyis mkho na rtsa bar snang bas gzhung der mdo lugs dang sngags lugs gnyis su gsungs pa'i dang po ni/

rgyal tshab byams pa dang thogs med sku mched nas brgyud pa dpal ldan a ti sha'i gdams ngag jo bo bka' gdams pa rnams kyi phyag bzhes te/ dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod mi dgos shing rten rnams thub pa'i dbang por bskyed pa la mdo lugs zhes tha snyad du mdzad pa las/ bdag bum rten gyi bskyed chog yan lag bzhi tshang bar dgos pas don la rgyud sde 'og ma dang gtso bor 'brel ba thun mong pa'i lugs so// gnyis pa ni/ rgyud sde rnams las gsungs shing grub pa'i slob dpon so sos bkral ba ltar rgyud sde'i dkyil 'khor bzhengs shing rten rnams kyang der bskyed pa sogs sngags kyi lugs thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos dang ldan pa'o// de gnyis ka lta'ang phyis su rgyas 'bring bsdus pa'i phyag len mang du spros par snang ba las/ 'dir nye bar mkho ba'i dbang gis bsdus pa dang shin tu bsdus pa'i lag len bshad par bya ste/ de'ang slob dpon a bhā yas/ mdor bsdus pa'i rab gnas bya ba ni/ sku gzugs la sogs pa stong pa nyid kyi rjes la skad cig gis de dang de'i dam tshig sems dpa' spyan dang sku la sogs pa byin gyis brlab pa bskyed nas/ de la de'i ye shes sems dpa' rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis bkug nas cug la/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis bkug pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa la sogs pa dag rang gis kyang bum pa'i chus dbang bskur te mchod nas de'i sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas so// zhes pas ni sku gzugs la sogs pa'i rab tu gnas par 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs pa rtsa bar bzung nas slob dpon rnams kyis phyag bzhes ci rigs mdzad pa las/ 'dir dpal rang byung zhabs kyi bzhed pa ltar 'chad pa la gnyis/ mdo lugs dang*/ sngags lugs so// dang po mdo lugs ltar na gsum/ sta gon/ dngos gzhi/ rjes kyi bya ba'o// dang po la gsum/ yo byad/ cho ga rten gyi sta gon no// dang po ni/

gang la rab gnas bya ba'i rten gyi mdun tu stegs bu gtsang ma'i dbus su mchod pa'i maṇḍal tshom bu bdun ma la bkra shis rtags brgyad ri mor bris pas bskor ba'am/ stabs bder byed na tsa ka li mi bzhag par maṇḍal tshom bu so bdun ma bkod kyang rung*/ de'i g.yas su bum gdan padma 'dab brgyad dam tshom bu'i khar rnam rgyal bum pa mgul chings ser po bzang shing gi kha rgyan gyi gseb tu dung chos 'o mas bkang ba gzungs rdor dang bcas pa/ nang du dri bzang gi chu dang nyer lnga'i rdzas kyis bkang ba bzhag g.yon phyogs su las bum bcud ldan mgul chings ljang gu can/ mdun tu chu gnyis nyer spyod phreng tshar/ tsā ru'i bza' ba dkar gsum gyi zhal zas ci 'byor/ phyogs gcig tu chos skyong gi gtor ma dmar gtor rgyan ldan cig 'thor nas 'bru dkar bzang po/ me long sku phyi na bza' sogs khrus kyi chas/ gu gul/ yungs kar/ dri bzang gi chu snod/ sbyong gtor/ til nag sogs nye bar mkho ba rnams tshogs par bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ sangs rgyas chos chogs sogs kyis skyabs sems lan gsum sngon tu song nas/ dpon slob thams cad kyis don zhags las 'byung ba'i theg pa chen po'i gso sbyong len par grub na lugs 'dir dmigs su gsungs pas shin tu legs so// gang ltar slob dpon nyid bsnyen sogs las su rung ba'i yi dam bdag bskyed bsdus pa zhig bsgom la bzlas pa cung zad bya'o// de'ang da lta'i tshul dang mthun pa la bde phag rgyal rgyam mi 'khrugs pa sgrol dkar lta bu gang byed kyang khyad par med cing*/ bde mchog la mtshon na kun mkhyen bstan pa'i nyin byed kyis mdzad pa'i lhan skyes sgom bzlas tsam bya zhing*/ bzlas pa grub ma thag par bum bskyed la 'jug pa las bsdu ldangs lugs 'dir ma gsungs so// de nas rnam rgyal bum pa hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags kyis bsang*/ swā bhā bas sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las padma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa gzhal yas khang gi ngo bo'i dbus su rin po che'i khri dang padma'i steng du oṃ ye dharma he tu pra bha wa he tunte ṣānta thā ga to hya ba da ta te ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e wam̐ bā dī ma hā shra ma ṇaḥswā hā/

gser gyi kha dog can las 'od 'phros sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das thub pa chen po sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu/ mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang dpe byad brgyad cus brgyan pa/ sa gnon mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya can/ chos gos rnam pa gsum gyis klubs pa/ thugs kar zla ba'i steng du rten 'brel snying po 'od dang bcas pa de las 'od 'phros sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs par gyur/ badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badzra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ pā dyaṃ/ puṣpe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gandhre/ nai wi dya/ shabda/ rnam dag sku mnga' mchog tu gzugs bzang ba// ye shes rgya mtsho gser gyi lhun po 'dra// grags pa 'jig rten gsum na lhang nge ba// mgon po mchog gyur rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥdam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ bdag nyid lha'i thugs ka nas sngags kyi 'od zer byung*/ gzungs thag la brgyud bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs kar phog pas thugs kyi rgyud bskul/ rten 'brel snying po las bdud rtsi dkar po babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur/ gzungs thag 'jus la/ na mo buddhā ya/ na mo dharmā ya/ na massaṃ ghā ya/ oṃ ye dharmā sogs rten snying ci 'grub bzlas pa'i mthar/ oṃ badzra sa twa hūm̐ gis dung zhal phul bas/ bum pa'i lha bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun tu gyur/ las bum mi dmigs pa stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i steng du rin po che'i bum pa'i dbus su/ pad nyi la hūm̐ las khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba sku mdog ljang sngon g.yas rdo rje'i dbyug pa dang*/ g.yon sdigs mdzub can khro bo'i chas dang ldan pa zhags brkyang bskum gyis bzhengs pa'i gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ thugs kar hūm̐ la sngags kyis bskor ba'i 'od kyis ye shes pa spyan drangs/ badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badzra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ oṃ badzra pā sha hūm̐/ oṃ badzra spho ṭa baṃ/ oṃ badzra ghaṇḍe hoḥ

gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang hūm̐ gi 'od kyis rigs lnga spyan drangs/ oṃ badzra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ zhes dbang bskur bas dri ma dag ste don yod grub pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las khro bo'i rang bzhin gyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ci 'grub dang*/ khrus kyi don tu/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ye shri hūm̐/ zhes pa'ang ci 'grub bzla/ mthar/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pas rab tu gnas pa'i bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du bgegs zlog pa dang bar chad bsrung ba'i phrin las mdzod cig me tog la/ 'bru rnams rten 'brel snying po'i yig 'bru'i rang bzhin gser btso ma'i kha dog tu gyur/ na mo buddhā ya sogs ye dhar chen mo ci rigs bzla/ dri sku gsung thugs ye shes rdo rje'i bdud rtsir gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ bzla/ yungs kar khro bo dang khro chung gi sprin dpag tu med par gyur/ zhes gul yungs la hūm̐ bzhi pa dang a mṛ ta bzlas pas byin brlab bo// gsum pa la/ bgegs sbyong ba ni/ gtor ma cog rdog gsum po rten la bskor zhing*/ sarba bighnan na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyo bi shwa ma khe bhyaḥsarba thā khaṃ utga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛhṇe daṃ ba lyā di swā hā/ zhes gsum dang*/ rten rab tu gnas pa la bar du gcod pa'i gdon bgegs zhi bas spyad par 'os pa thams cad gtor ma 'dis tshim par gyis la gnas gzhan du song zhig zhes gtor ma snod du spungs te gnas dpags/ ting lo changs bu bskor zhing*/ suṃ bhas bskrad pa lan gsum mthar/ rten rab tu gnas pa la bar du gcod pa'i gdon bgegs zhi drag phyed mas sbyang bar 'os pa thams cad ting lo changs bu dang bcas pas tshim par gyis la gzhan du song zhig gal te mi 'gro ba de dag rdo rje'i me lces brlag par 'gyur ro// zhes brjod la/

gtor ma phyir btang*/ rang nyid skad cig gis rdo rje khro bo'i skur gyur pa'i thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis khro bo'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spyan drangs par gyur/ 'dir spro na/ hūm̐/ ye shes bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i 'od// ma rig 'dod pa'i mun khams thams cad sreg /zhe sdang gshin rje'i 'jigs pa thams cad 'joms// dpa' bo chen po dpa' mtshan stag lpags can// log 'dren srin po'i mtha' gnon dgra 'dul ba// rig pa'i rgyal po khro bo bzhugs so 'tshal// log 'dren 'dul ba'i slad du spyan 'dren na// 'gro ba'i don du mchod kyis gshegs su gsol// ces brjod/ gang ltar yang*/ oṃ badzra ma hā kro dha rā dza sa pa ri bā ra badzra sa mā dzraḥ oṃ badzra kro dha rā dza sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ sogs btags pas mchod/ hūm̐/ 'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra nges sgrog cing*// bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms mdzad pa// dngos grub ma lus stsol ba'i lha// bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces pa tsam gyis bstod nas/ hūm̐/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i sa gzhi la gnas pa'i// lha la sogs pa'i bgegs tshogs kun nyon cig /nga ni gnas 'dir rab tu gnas pa sgrub// khyod rnams 'di nas gzhan du 'gro bar gyis// gal te nga yi bka' las 'da' byed na// ye shes can gyi rdo rje 'bar ba yis// mgo bo tshal pa brgyar ni 'gems 'gyur zhing*// bgegs rnams brlag par 'gyur ba gdon mi za// zhes bsgos te/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta dang suṃ bha'i drag sngags yungs thun sogs kyis bskrad/ oṃ badzra rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ lan gsum/ bdag dang gnas dang rnal 'byor bsrung bar gyur/ zhes srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgoms la mtshams bcing ngo*// byur bsal ba ni/ bdag dang sbyin bdag rten gyi snying gar kāṃ las sdig sgrib kyi ngo bo sdig pa'i gzugs su gyur pa lte ba nas hūm̐ las rdo rje gnod sbyin du gyur pas sna sgo'i lam nas ded cing mdun gyi til la thim par gyur/

til me chur dor la/ oṃ badzra kro dha tre lo kya bi dza ya kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba pā paṃ da ha na bhasmin ku ru hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ lan gsum mthar/ g.yas su ye shes kyi mer bsregs g.yon tu rgya mtsho chen por dor bas byang zhing dag par gyur/ zhes kyang brjod de phyir dor ro// de nas bkru zhing phyi ba ni me long khrus dar dang las bum thogs la/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa bde bar gshegs pa 'jig rten mkhyen pa skyes bu 'dul ba kha lo sgyur ba bla na med pa lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la bdag gis yo byad thams cad dang ldan pa'i khrus 'di gsol bar bgyi'o// zhes snyan brnan/ khrus kyi khang pa shin tu dri zhim pa// shel gyi sa gzhi gsal zhing 'tsher ba star// rin chen 'bar ba'i ka ba yid 'ong ldan// mu tig 'od chags bla re bres pa der// stong gsum kun tu dri ngad ldang ba yi// dri mchog rnams kyis thub dbang rnams kyi sku// gser sbyangs btso ma byi dor byas pa ltar// 'od chags 'bar ba de dag byug par bgyi// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bi sho dha ni swā hā/ zhes dri'i 'dag chal byug khro chen bdud rtsi 'khyil ba yi// byin rlabs ye shes chu yis ni// rgyal ba'i sku la khrus gsol bas// sgrib pa'i tshogs rnams dag gyur cig /oṃ a mṛ ta sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis khrus gsol lo// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs sngags/ 'di ni khrus mchog dpal dang ldan// thugs rje'i chu ni bla na med// byin rlabs ye shes chu yin te// ci 'dod dngos grub stsol bar mdzod// sngags/ rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs la nyon mongs mi mnga' yang*// sems can lus ngag yid gsum sgrib pa sbyang slad du// rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs la khrus chab 'di gsol bas// sems can lus ngag yid gsum sgrib pa dag gyur cig

/na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wāktsitta bi sho dha ni hūm̐/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang de sras la// rin chen bum pa mang po spos kyi chu// yid 'ong legs par gang ba glu dang ni// rol mor bcas pa du mas sku khrus gsol// nyin mo bde legs sogs dang sngags brjod la khrus gsol/ rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras kyi sku rnams la// ras dkar sman dang ldan pas sku phyis pas// mi shes sgrib pa ma lus kun bsal nas// nyes pa'i tshogs rnams ma lus dag gyur cig /oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.aḥkā ya bi sho dha ni swā hā/ zhes khrus ras kyis phyi/ gos zung thogs la/ srab 'jam yang ba lha yi gos// mi bskyod rdo rje'i sku brnyes la// mi phyed dad pas bdag 'bul na// bdag kyang rdo rje'i sku thob shog /oṃ badzra wast+ra āḥhūm̐/ sna tshogs dbang po'i gzhu ltar rab bkra zhing*// gang la reg na bde ba'i rgyur gyur pa// gos bzang rin chen bdag blo sbyang phyir 'bul// bzod pa dam pa'i gos kyis brgyan par shog /oṃ badzra wast+ra āḥhūm̐/ zhes dbul lo// gnyis pa cho ga'i dngos gzhi la gsum/ rten sgrub pa/ rab tu gnas pa/ mnga' 'bul ba'o// dang po la rten bskyed pa ni/ bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i khri'i steng du pam̐ las padma dang a las zla ba'i steng du/ ye dharmā he tu pra bha wa he tunte ṣānta thā ga to hya ba data te ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e wam̐ bā dī ma hā shra ma ṇaḥ zhes brjod cing*/ sngags phreng 'od dang bcas pa g.yas bskor du 'khor ba de las 'od 'phros/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das thub pa chen po sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ phyag g.yas sa gnon dang g.yon mnyam gzhag gi steng na lhung bzed bsnams pa/ chos gos ngur smrig gsol ba/ dbu la gtsug tor dang zhabs la 'khor lo sogs mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng du/

ye dharmā nas shra ma ṇaḥ'i bar brjod/ ces pa'i sngags phreng 'od dang bcas pa g.yas skor du 'khor ba de las 'od 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur/ spos dang rol mo bcas/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'dzoms mdzad lha// dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa// bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// ji ltar sangs rgyas rnams ni dga' ldan nas// sprul pa dam pa tog dkar lha yi bu// mi pham mgon la rgyal tshab dbang bskur nas// gzigs pa rnam bzhis 'dzam bu'i gling gzigs shing*// glang chen thal dkar ltar gshegs lhums zhugs bzhin// rdo rje rin chen padma'i rigs mchog dang*// las kyi rigs dang de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs// phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams// dus 'dir bdag gis dad pas spyan 'dren na// rten mchog 'di la 'byon par mdzad du gsol// na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta sa ma ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bcom ldan khyod ni byon pa legs// bdag cag bsod nams skal bar ldan// bdag gi mchod yon bzhes slad du// 'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol// stong gsum kun dang mnyam pa yi// padma 'dab brgyad ge sar bcas// bde zhing yangs par 'bul lags na// ci bde bar ni bzhugs su gsol// padma ka ma lā ye st+waṃ/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ bstod par 'os pa thams cad la// zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyi// lus btud pa yis rnam kun tu// mchog tu gus pas phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bstod la/ snyan gsan dbab pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams na bzhugs pa rnams dgongs su gsol/ sems can thams cad la phan pa dang bde ba'i don gyi phyir dang*/

khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i don tu rab tu gnas pa bgyid par 'tshal na 'dus pa thams cad byin gyis brlabs pa dang da ltar rten 'di la 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod la me tog 'thor zhing rol mo bsgrag 'di dag gi skabs su me tog ni byin rlabs ma byas pa'i 'bru 'thor dgos so// de nas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ 'di ltar bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa bde bar gshegs pa 'jig rten mkhyen pa skyes bu 'dul ba kha lo bsgyur ba/ bla na med pa lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das skyes bu chen po'i mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus brgyan pa/ yon tan thams cad kyi mnga' bdag rdo rje'i rigs dang*/ rin po che'i rigs dang*/ padma'i rigs dang*/ las kyi rigs dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs la sogs pa phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' yas mu med pa na bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams 'gro ba lha dang bcas pa la phan pa dang bde ba'i phyir rten 'di rnams la 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ zhes me tog 'thor zhing rol chen dang bcas pa lan gsum du brjod pa'i tha ma la/ byon nas kyang brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ zhes brjod la sngar nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i ye shes pa rnams rten la thim par mos/ de nas/ oṃ na mo bha ga ba te shākya mu na ye ta thā ga tā ya arha te samya ksaṃ buddha ya/ tadya thā/ oṃ mu ni mu ni ma hā mu na ye swā hā/ zhes ci rigs su bzla zhing byams pa dang snying rje byang chub sems yun ring du bsgoms la rten dang don dam gyi ye shes dbyer med la ci gnas su mnyam par bzhag go /de nas phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams 'bru dang tha dad med par byon nas rten so so la thim pas gnyis su med par gyur/ oṃ na mo buddha ya sogs ye dhar chen mo brjod cing byin gyis brlabs pa'i me tog gi char dbab/

rol mo bsgrags la/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra// 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dri ma gsum spangs pa// sangs rgyas padma rgyas pa 'dab 'dra'i spyan mnga' ba// 'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis dang po'o// de yis nye bar bstan pa'i mchog rab mi g.yo ba// 'jig rten gsum na grags shing lha dang mis mchod pa// chos kyi dam pa skye dgu rnams la zhi byed pa// 'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gnyis pa'o// dge 'dun dam pa chos ldan thos pa'i bkra shis phyug /mi dang lha dang lha ma yin gyis mchod pa'i gnas// tshogs kyi mchog rab ngo tsha shes dang dpal gyi gzhi// 'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gsum pa'o// de nas rnam rgyal bum pa thogs la/ bdag dang bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul/ de rnams kyis rin po che'i bum pa phyag tu thogs nas byon te dbang bskur bar gyur/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis khrus gsol lo// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ye shri hūm̐/ zhes brjod la bum chu 'thor/ rten dngos sam me long du shar ba la/ dri'i chus gnas gsum du reg ste/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs dang dbyer med par gyur/ gser gyi thur ma thogs la spyan dbye tshul bya zhing*/ kun mkhyen ye shes spyan ldan skyon bral yang*// gus pas 'phags pa'i spyan ni dbye bgyis pas// nam mkha'i mthas gtugs gyur pa'i sems can rnams// sangs rgyas ye shes spyan ni thob par shog /oṃ tsakṣuḥtsakṣuḥs manta tsakṣurbi sho dha ni swā hā/ shes bya thams cad la gzigs pa'i spyan phun sum tshogs pa mnga' zhing sbyin bdag la zhi bas gzigs pa lhur len par gyur/

gnyis pa ni/ slob dpon gyi rdo rjes rten la reg cing*/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa ma thob kyi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ bye brag tu rten 'di rnams 'byung ba chen po bzhi'i gnod pas zhig par ma gyur gyi bar du sems can gyi don du sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams rten 'di rnams la brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzrā ye swā hā/ zhes brjod la rten zhal bsgyur ba ni/ mgon po skal ba ji bzhin du// sna tshogs gzugs ni bzung nas kyang*// phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams kun tu// des ni 'gro ba'i don kun mdzod// bcom ldan 'das thub pa chen po 'od du zhu ba las sku gsung thugs kyi rten so so'i rnam par gyur/ gsum pa la gnyis/ spyir mchod bstod kyis mnga' dbul ba dang*/ bye brag rdzas kyis mnga' dbul ba'o// dang po ni/ mchod pa rnams slar kha gsos la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi byin gyis brlabs pa'i stobs dang*/ bdag gi bsod nams dang smon lam gyi stobs dang*/ rig sngags kyi stobs kyis sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rnams la mchog tu rgya chen po byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa las mngon par mtho ba'i mchod pa'i sprin chen po rab tu 'phro bar gyur cig na maḥsarba buddha bo ddhi satwā nāṃ sarba thā khaṃ utga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ sa manta swā hā/ lan brgyad kyis byin brlab/ 'jig rten khams ni dpag med na// mchod yon ji snyed yod pa dang*// bdag gis gus pas bshams pa 'dis// rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams mchod// na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta arghaṃ pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra sphar ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/

de bzhin du/ mchod yon ces pa'i gnas su/ zhabs bsil ces dang*/ arghaṃ zhes pa'i gnas su pā dyaṃ/ me tog puṣpe/ bdug spos/ dhū pe/ snang gsal/ ā lo ke/ dri chab/ gandhe/ zhal zas/ nai wi dya/ sgra snyan/ shabda/ zhes sbyar bas phyi mchod 'bul/ phyogs dus kun na gzugs sgra dri dang ro// reg bya'i khyad par dbang po tshims byed rnams// mos blos rgyal ba sras bcas la 'bul na// bzhes nas bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta rū pa shabda gandhe rā sa sparṣe kā ma gu ṇa badzra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes 'dod yon lnga 'bul/ spro na/ oṃ/ rdo rje sems dpa' bsdus pa ni// oṃ badzra lā se hūm̐/ rdo rje rin chen bla na med// oṃ badzra ma le trāṃ/ rdo rje chos ni glur blangs pa// oṃ badzra gī ti hrīḥ rdo rje las kun byed par gyur// oṃ badzra nṛ tye āḥ zhes nang gi lha mo bzhis mchod/ yang*/ oṃ badzra sa twa su saṃ gra hā tāṃ/ oṃ badzra dhū pe hūm̐/ badzra ratna ma nutta raṃ/ oṃ badzra puṣpe traṃ/ badzra dharma gā ya nī/ oṃ badzra ā lo ke hrīḥ badzra karma ka ro ta bha we/ oṃ badzra gandhe āḥ zhes phyi'i lha mo bzhi'i mchod pa ste/ sgeg sogs lha mo brgyad kyis kyang mchod la/ de las gzhan yang mchod pa'i tshogs// rol mo dbyangs snyan yid 'ong ldan// sems can sdug bsngal sem byed pa'i// sprin rnams so sor gnas gyur cig /dam chos dkon mchog thams cad dang*// mchod rten rnams dang sku gzugs la// rin chen me tog la sogs char// rgyun mi chad par 'bab par shog /ji ltar 'jam dbyangs la sogs pas// rgyal ba rnams la mchod mdzad pa// de bzhin bdag gis de bzhin gshegs// mgon po sras dang bcas rnams mchod// yon tan rgya mtsho rnams la bdag /bstod dbyangs yan lag rgya mtshos bstod// bstod dbyangs snyan sprin de dag la// nges par kun tu 'byung gyur cig

/ces brjod/ bstod pa ni/ dkon mchog rjes dran nam/ mnyam med mi g.yo mnyam med mchog gi chos nyid can// thugs rje'i bdag nyid 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sel bar mdzad// yon tan mtha' yas dngos grub thams cad sbyin mdzad pa// dri med mi g.yo mnyam med dam pa'i mchog chos can// yon tan shin tu phra ba'i cha la'ang tshad med de// dpe ni nam mkha' dang yang bskrun du yod ma yin// dngos grub mtha' yas mnyam med dpe dang bral ba rnams// sems can khams la dngos grub mchog rnams nges par stsol// rtag tu dri ma med pa thugs rje'i shugs las byung*// smon lam grub pa 'gag pa med pa'i chos nyid can// 'gro ba'i don sgrub rab tu brtson pa mtha' yas pa// thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid rtag tu rnam par snang*// tshad med tshad dang bral ba shin tu rdzogs pa yi// bde bar gshegs pa'i go 'phang dam pa brnyes gyur kyang*// khams gsum rnams la dngos grub mchog stsol mdzad pa yi// thugs rje'i spyod pa mi g.yo 'gags par yongs mi 'gyur// e ma ho shin tu bzang po'i chos nyid mchog dang ldan// mchog sbyin rnams kyi nang nas go 'phang mchog brnyes pa// khams gsum kun la rtag tu dngos grub mchog stsol mdzad// mgon po dus gsum sgrib pa med par rab mkhyen pas// dam tshig mchog gsum dngos grub dam pa bdag la stsol// 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// yang dag yon tan rgyas pa ste// lan gcig tsam zhig brjod pas kyang*// gsang sngags thams cad 'grub par 'gyur// ces sangs rgyas spyi'i bstod pas bstod kyang legs/ bsdu na/ rgyal ba zla ba dri ma med pa'i sku// rgyal ba nyi ma 'od zer stong gi 'od// rgyal ba padma dri ma med pa'i spyan// rgyal ba me tog pad rtsa rdul med tshems// rgyal ba'i yon tan rgya mtsho lta bu ste// rin po che ni du ma'i 'byung gnas gyur// rgyal ba rgya mtsho ye shes chu yis gang*// ting 'dzin brgya phrag stong gis kun tu bzang*// rgyal ba'i zhabs ni 'khor los bris pa ste// khor yug mu khyud de bzhin rtsibs ma steng*// phyag dang zhabs ni drwa bas spras pa ste// zhabs kyi drwa ba ngang pa'i dbang po bzhin// gser gyi ri bo lta bur rab tu gda'// rgyal ba dri med gser gyi ri dbang po// yon tan thams cad ri dbang 'dra ba ste// sangs rgyas ri dbang rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba chu zla 'dra// nam mkha' dang yang mtshungs shing 'dra ba ste// sgyu ma smig rgyu lta bur chags pa med// rgyal ba dri ma med la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces brjod/

gnyis pa bye brag rdzas kyis mnga' dbul ba ni/ gling bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa'i ri bo/ khrus chab/ na bza' rgyal srid bdun/ 'phan gdugs sogs/ bkra shis rtags rdzas/ 'dod yon lnga/ lnga phrag lnga/ seng ge'i khri rnams rim par phul la/ sa gzhi spos chus byugs shing me tog bkram// ri rab gling bzhi nyi zlas brgyan pa 'di// sangs rgyas zhing du dmigs te phul ba yis// 'gro kun rnam dag zhing la spyod par shog /oṃ badzra re khe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ stong gsum kun tu dri ngad ldang ba yi// dri mchog rnams kyis thub dbang rnams kyi sku// gser sbyangs btso ma byi dor byas pa ltar// 'od chags 'bar ba de dag byugs par bgyi// oṃ badzra gandhe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ sna tshogs dbang po'i gzhu ltar rab bkra zhing*// gang la reg na bde ba'i rgyur gyur pa'i// gos bzang rin chen bdag blo sbyang phyir 'bul// bzod pa dam pa'i gos kyis brgyan par shog /oṃ badzra wast+ra āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ mi dbang rin chen sna bdun 'di dag ni// rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa ma lus la// bshams shing yid kyis sprul te phul ba yis// 'gro ba mi zad gter la spyod par shog /oṃ sapta ma hā ratna pū dza me gha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ theg mchog bla bre gdugs dang ba dan dang*// bdud bcom rgyal mtshan lhab lhub ting 'dzin 'phan// gar dang rol mo mchod pa'i sgra dbyangs kyis// rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor mdzes par brgyan par bgyi// oṃ badzra ma hā pū dza me gha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ lha yi dbang po lha min g.yul rgyal nas// bkra shis lha mo brgyad kyis mchod pa ltar// rgyal ba rnams dang byang chub sems dpa' la// bkra shis rdzas brgyad dag gis mchod par bgyi// 'jig rten khyim bdag rnams ni dpal bsten nas// bil ba star ga bum pa bzang dang bcas// mdun du bdar nas bkra shis byed pa ltar// rgyal ba sras dang bcas la 'bul bar bgyi// oṃ aṣṭa maṅga la pū dza me gha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/

gzugs sgra dri ro reg ldan pa'i// mchog tu gyur pa'i longs spyod rnams// bdag gis dad pas 'bul bar bgyi// ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol// oṃ badzra pañtsa kā ma gu ṇa pū dzi te āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ rgyal ba mgon po dpal gyis lham mer bzhugs// bsod nams ye shes sku lnga brnyes pa la// lnga phrag lnga ldan snying po dam pa 'bul// 'gro bas bde gshegs snying po thob par shog /oṃ badzra pañtsa bi ma la pū dza me gha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ rin chen du ma las grub seng ge'i khri// yid 'phrog sna tshogs gos kyis bkang ba 'di// spros bral rgyal ba rnams la phul ba yis// 'gro kun rdo rje'i gdan la bzhugs par shog /oṃ badzra siṃ ha ā sa na āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ tsā ru'i bza' ba/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyo bi shwa mu khe bhyaḥsarba thā khaṃ utga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ zhes byin gyis brlabs la/ zhal zas ro brgya ldan cing yid 'phrog pa// legs sbyar 'di ni rgyal ba sras bcas la// dad pas phul bas 'gro ba 'di dag kun// 'byor ldan ting 'dzin zas la spyod par shog /oṃ badzra dī bya anne sa mā dhi dhya na pre ṇa āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes 'bul lo// sngags kyi mnga' dbul ni/ slob dpon gyis rdo rjes rten la reg pa'am gzungs thag btags pa'i sna bzung*/ thams cad kyis me tog 'thor la/ na mo buddha ya sogs yedhar chen mo dang*/ oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzre swā hā/ oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥbhrūm̐ kham̐ badzra bha wadṛ ḍha tiṣṭha bhū khaṃ swā hā/ zhes pa rnams la re re zhing nyer gcig gam bdun tsam bzlas nas bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad ji ltar rigs pa'ang brjod do// gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba la/ gtor ma btang ba ni/ grub na dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa'i phyi rol du cha gsum gtor ma btang*/ de nas ma mgon lcam dral dang rnam thos sras la sogs pa la gtor chog mdor bsdus pas gtor ma bsngo ste 'dir mtshon na/

ma dag snod bcud sogs rgyun gyi gtor bsngo bsdus pa'am/ yang na rgyal rgyam lha lnga'i nang gi/ oṃ/ chos dbyings rnam dag ngang las rlung me dang*// sogs kyis gtor ma btang ba'i rjes su/ gta' gtor btegs la/ chos skyong ba'i srung ma khyed rnams kyis rab tu gnas par byas pa'i rten 'di rnams kyi yon bdag gyis la phyi ma'i mu mthar thug gi bar du srungs shig skyobs shig phrin las spel cig ces brjod pa'i mthar rol chen dang bcas te gta' gtor rten gyi drung du de nyid la phyogs pas bzhag de nas mchod cing bzod par gsol ba ni/ mchod pa bzang du bshams la/ me tog dam pa phreng ba dam pa dang*// sogs bzang spyod las gsungs pa'i mchod pa'i yan lag gi tshigs bcad gsum gyis mchod/ yig brgya lan gsum dang*/ rdzogs sangs rgyas dang de yi sras// tshangs sogs lha yi tshogs rnams kyis// gang dag cho ga bya ba la// 'gal zhing 'khrul pa gang mchis dang*// ma tshang ba dang lhag pa rnams// nongs par gyur pa gang lags te// kun tu bzod par mdzad du gsol// sbyin bdag bsgo ba dang de'i shis brjod sogs ni bsdus pa'i skabs 'dir ma gsungs la gal te spro bar 'dod na gzhan dang mthun no// de nas slob dpon la ci 'byor pa'i yon 'bul ba sogs dga' ston bya zhing*/ des kyang dge ba'i rtsa ba bla na med pa'i byang chub tu bsngo// rjes shis pa brjod pa ni/ ston mchog dam par lha mis mchod 'os pa// sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba// de dag thams cad deng 'dir bde legs shog /zhi ba chags bral lha mis mchod 'os pa// chos la phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba// de dag thams cad deng 'dir bde legs shog /tshogs kyi dam pa lha mis mchod 'os pa// dge 'dun phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba// de dag thams cad deng 'dir bde legs shog

/ces sngon tu 'gro ba'i bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa rgyas par brjod cing me tog 'thor ba dang rol mo'i sgra bsgrag go /de ltar bsdus pa'i cho ga dag kyang mi 'grub pas ni rje dgu pas mdzad pa'i rab gnas bsdus pa rigs gnyis sam/ yang na rtsa ba'i dgongs pa bslad med ltar sems bskyed la rang yi dam du skad cig gis gsal/ drag sngags kyis bgegs bskrad/ swa bhā bas rten sbyangs la thub pa'i dbang por bskyed/ sku gsung thugs byin brlab/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad rten 'di rnams la 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab la ye dharmā brjod cing me tog 'thor/ gsol gdab kyi gsham/ rten 'di rnams la brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ zhes dang*/ su pra tiṣṭha brjod la zhal bsgyur/ mchod bstod mdor bsdus kyis mnga' dbul zhing bkra shis brjod pas 'grub bo// gnyis pa sngags lugs kyi rab gnas bsdus pa ni/ dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod dang 'brel na bsham bkod kyi spros pa'ang so so'i lugs bzhin la/ rab gnas kyi yo byad ni sngar dang mtshungs/ thog mar bdag mdun bum pa sgrub cing bdag nyid 'jug pa sogs grub pa dang*/ dri dang me tog sogs byin brlabs la sbyang khrus bya/ rten rnams dkyil 'khor gang yin gyi lha der bskyed/ dbang bskur rgyas gdab so so'i lugs bzhin bya/ mchod bstod kyang de mtshungs dang tsā ru'i bza' ba'i skabs gtor 'bum dang tshogs kyi 'khor lo bya/ rjes chog gong smos grub nas slar dkyil 'khor gyi rjes chog rnams bya/ gzhan gong du smos pa ltar ro// dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod dang ma 'brel ba'i shin tu bsdus par 'dod na/ rnam rgyal bum pa mgul chings dkar po/ kha rgyan ku sha sogs gzugs/ bdag bskyed gang la brten pa'i gtor 'bul spro na gtor ma 'du bya/ yo byad gzhan gang dang mtshungs/ gso sbyong mi dgos pas/ thog mar skyabs sems nas brtsams bdag gi rnal 'byor bzlas pa bcas bya/

de nas rnam bum bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i steng du bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang gzhal yas khang du gyur pa'i dbus su pad zla'i gdan la hūm̐ dkar po las 'od 'phros don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' dkar gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhi zhing 'dzum pa'i nyams can dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ g.yas rdo rje thugs kar gtod cing g.yon dril bu dkur brten pa/ zhabs sems skyil gyis bzhugs pa'i gnas gsum 'bru gsum gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ rang 'dra'i ye shes pa spyan drangs badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ slar yang dbang lha 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis lha la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang lha rnams kyis/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta aḥbhi ṣe ka te sa ma ye shri hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ nas shabda pra tītstsha swā hās mchod/ rdo rje sems dpa' sems dpa' che// rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa kun// rdo rje dang po kun tu bzang*// phyag 'tshal rdo rje sems dpa' la'o// zhes bstod/ rang gi thugs ka'i 'od zer gzungs thag las brgyud de bum lha'i thugs kar phog pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs bum pa gang bar gyur/ zhes mos la yig brgya dang yang snying ci 'grub bzla/ mthar 'od zhu dang*/ las bum sgrub pa/ dri sogs byin rlabs/ sbyong khrus sogs gong du bshad pa ltar la/ rten bskyed pa'i skabs su slob dpon kun dga' snying pos/ rdo rje slob dpon gang zhig la// mtshan mi shes pa'i lha rnams ni// rab tu gnas par byed pa na// the tshom gyur pas bzhag bya min// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi// thugs kyi ngo bo rdo rje sems// yin pas 'gal bar mi 'gyur phyir// rdo rje sems dpas rab gnas bya'o// zhes gsungs pas/

thams cad rdor sems gong smos ltar bskyed kyang shin tu rung mod kyi/ rigs lnga so sor bskyed par spro na/ rten bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las sku rten dang mchod rten gtsug lag khang la sogs pa seng ges btegs pa'i khri sna tshogs padma nyi zla brtsegs pa'i steng du oṃ las 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa las rnam snang dkar po g.yas 'khor lo dang g.yon dril bu 'dzin pa/ spyan ma dkar mo g.yas 'khor lo dang g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ de bzhin du/ glegs bam rnams rma byas btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs padma dang nyi zla brtsegs pa'i steng du oṃ las padma oṃ gis mtshan pa las snang ba mtha' yas dmar po g.yas padma dang g.yon dril bu 'dzin pa/ gos dkar mo dmar mo g.yas padma dang g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ phyag mtshan rnams glang pos btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs padma nyi zla brtsegs pa'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las mi bskyod pa sngon po g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon dril bu 'dzin pa/ dbyings phyug ma sngon mo g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ bang mdzod dang rin po che'i rigs rnams rta mchog gis btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs padma nyi zla brtsegs pa'i steng du swā las rin po che swās mtshan pa las rin chen 'byung ldan ser po g.yas rin po che dang g.yon dril bu 'dzin pa/ ma mā ki ser mo g.yas rin po che dang g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ rol mo go cha srung ba'i rigs rnams shang shang gis btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs padma nyi zla brtsegs pa'i steng du hā las rgya gram hās mtshan pa las don yod grub pa ljang gu g.yas rgya gram dang g.yon dril bu 'dzin pa/

dam tshig sgrol ma ljang gu g.yas rgya gram dang g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ thams cad kyang zhi zhing 'dzum la mtshan dpe'i lang tsho rab tu rgyas pa dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing 'od zer mtha' yas par spro ba'i bdag nyid can du bzhugs pa'o// de rnams kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po rnams kyis mtshan par bsam mo// bdag dang rten gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes kyi 'khor lo bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i tshogs thams cad oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ de nas spyan drangs pa sogs sngar ltar la/ snying po yig brgya bzla/ dbang bskur ba'i skabs/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las byung ba'i 'od zer gyis dbang gi lha de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga sras dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs nas mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa la/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ sogs nas shabda pra tītstsha swā hā/ zhes pas mchod/ chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang*// gzugs sku 'ja' tshon bzhin du so sor gsal// thabs dang shes rab mchog la mnga' brnyes pa'i// rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bstod nas/ rdo rje can gyis sangs rgyas la// 'gro ba skyob pa'i ched du dbang*// yon tan 'byung gnas ji ltar stsal// de ltar 'di la'ang stsal du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas nam mkha' gang ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzod/ yum rnams kyis bum pa'i chu rgyun gyis dbang bskur/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis pa'i glu dbyangs brjod/ lha mo rnams kyis gdugs dang ba dan la sogs pa bsgreng zhing rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas mchod rdzas kyi char 'bebs/ khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad pa'i las mdzad par bsam/ bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas// kun gyi bdag nyid rigs kun gyi ni bdag po mchog

/ma lus sems can skyed mdzad bde ba chen po ste// des ni deng khyod dbang bskur mchog la bkra shis shog /ces dang*/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// sogs nas/ de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes dbang bskur bas sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma spyi bor 'khyil pa las rnam snang sogs bdag por gyur pa'i rigs lngas dbu brgyan par bsam/ oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥpañtsa ku la mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ zhes dbu rgyan gyis dbang bskur/ oṃ truṃ/ zhes go bsgos/ oṃ tu ṣyu hoḥ zhes rdo rje thal mos mnyes par bya/ bstod pa nges par mnyam med mas bstod/ tshogs dang gtor 'bul spro na tsā ru'i bza' ba'i gong du bya/ mi spro na nges par dgos pa ma yin/ rjes bdag bskyed bsdu ldangs sogs bya'o// de las kyang bsdu na/ bdag bskyed sngon tu 'gro bas las bum bsgrub/ sbyong khrus nas brtsams rten bsgyur ba'i bar sngar bzhin la/ mchod bstod tsam dang sngags kyis mnga' dbul/ rjes mchod pa bzod gsol bsngo smon shis brjod dang*/ bdag bskyed kyi rjes chog byas pas 'grub bo// shin tu bsdu na/ bdag nyid skad cig gis rdo rje khro bo'i skur gyur/ drag sngags brjod cing bgegs bskrad/ rten bskyed/ spyan drang*/ dam ye bsre/ dbang bskur rgyas gdab bya/ spyan dbye/ zhal bsgyur la brtan bzhugs kyis gsol ba gdab la 'bru 'thor/ mchod bstod kyis mnga' dbul/ bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa brjod pas 'grub bo// bden gnyis dbyer med rab tu gnas pa'i tshul// rgya bod mkhas pa'i gzhung lugs bye ba'i bcud// rang byung rgyal ba gnyis pa'i dgongs don la// rang bzos ma bslad 'jug bder legs par bshad// kun rdzob rten la don dam ye shes kyi// snying po 'bral ba med par rtag bzhugs nas// mngon par mtho dang nges par legs pa yi// bkra shis rgya mtsho'i sprin chen bkod gyur cig

/ces pa'ang kun mkhyen bla ma 'jam mgon dgyes pa'i zhabs kyis bka'i gnang ba stsal ba dang*/ rang gzhan la phan par 'dod pa'i bsam pas karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtshos dpal spungs yang khrod kun bzang bde chen 'od gsal gling du rgyal ba lha las babs pa'i dkar phyogs kyi tshes bzang por sbyar ba dge legs 'phel// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
